records.title_cn: Carbon VIX：碳价格不确定性和脱碳投资
records.abstract_en: We study the effects of carbon price uncertainty on firms’ decisions to decarbonize their operations. We first use information on the pricing of options on emission allowances in the European Emissions Trading System to create the Carbon VIX, a market-based high-frequency measure of carbon price uncertainty. Carbon price uncertainty is high, varies substantially over time, and experiences persistent shocks around major climate policy events. To explore the effects of carbon price uncertainty on expected aggregate decarbonization investments, we analyze its effect on the stock returns of firms that help other businesses decarbonize. To identify these “carbon solution providers”, we extract common types of decarbonization investments from a large survey of firms, and then identify companies that offer the associated goods and services. We find that the stock returns of these carbon solution providers vary positively with carbon prices, but negatively with carbon price uncertainty. The effect of increases in carbon price uncertainty on our proxy for expected decarbonization investments is economically large and of similar magnitude as the effect of declines in carbon prices. These findings support predictions from real options theory that firms may delay investments in decarbonization when faced with uncertainty about the future costs of emissions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究碳价格不确定性对企业脱碳运营决策的影响。我们首先使用欧洲排放交易系统中排放配额期权定价的信息来创建Carbon VIX，这是一种基于市场的碳价格不确定性的高频衡量指标。碳价格的不确定性很高，随着时间的推移变化很大，并且会因重大气候政策事件而受到持续的冲击。为了探讨碳价格不确定性对预期总体脱碳投资的影响，我们分析了其对帮助其他企业脱碳的公司股票回报的影响。为了识别这些“碳解决方案提供商”，我们从对企业的大型调查中提取了常见的脱碳投资类型，然后识别提供相关商品和服务的公司。我们发现这些碳解决方案提供商的股票回报随碳价格呈正向变化，但随碳价格不确定性呈负向变化。碳价格不确定性的增加对我们预期脱碳投资的影响在经济上是巨大的，并且与碳价格下降的影响相似。这些发现支持了实物期权理论的预测，即当面临未来排放成本的不确定性时，企业可能会推迟脱碳投资。

records.title_en: Hold-up in the absence of individual rationality: Asymptotic efficiency and gradualism
records.title_cn: 缺乏个体理性时的劫持：渐近效率和渐进主义
records.abstract_en: The hold-up problem has given rise to a large and influential literature. We consider a bilateral hold-up problem where bargaining power is asymmetrically distributed among the agents, in particular investing at the efficient level is not “individually rational” for one of the agents. We demonstrate that in the presence of a rich natural setup – that allows for dynamics in transfers, investments and negotiations – there exist subgame perfect equilibria that achieve asymptotic efficiency. This is true both when investments by the two agents are substitutes, as well as when these are complements. Moreover, implementation requires gradualism, with sequential investments and transfers over several periods.
records.abstract_cn: 敲诈勒索问题催生了大量有影响力的文献。我们考虑双边劫持问题，其中讨价还价能力在代理人之间分布不对称，特别是在有效水平上的投资对于其中一个代理人来说不是“个体理性的”。我们证明，在存在丰富的自然设置（允许转让、投资和谈判动态）的情况下，存在实现渐近效率的子博弈完美均衡。当两个代理人的投资是替代性的以及互补性的时候都是如此。此外，实施需要循序渐进，分阶段进行连续投资和转移。

records.title_en: Investment sophistication and wealth inequality
records.title_cn: 投资 sophistication 与财富不平等
records.abstract_en: I study the stationary wealth distribution in a dynamic model of financial markets in which investors differ in their levels of investment sophistication. Some investors form beliefs rationally but have access to different information, while others hold incorrect beliefs. For all investor types, the stationary wealth distribution exhibits a thick upper tail, whose thickness depends on the higher moments of portfolio returns relative to the aggregate market. The upper tail of the overall stationary wealth distribution is populated by the group with the thickest tail. I show that this group is either a rational group with an undominated information set or the group with incorrect beliefs, despite the latter earning the lowest expected return. To explain the observed degrees of wealth concentration, it is sufficient that some investor groups earn an expected excess return of 0.89% per annum relative to the aggregate economy – consistent with the risk-adjusted returns generated by hedge funds and private equity funds and their portfolio shares among the ultra-wealthy in the United States. A calibration of the model matches the distribution of average returns for Norwegian households documented by Fagereng et al. (2020).
records.abstract_cn: 我研究了一个动态金融市场模型中的稳态财富分布，在该模型中，投资者的投资 sophistication 水平各不相同。一些投资者理性地形成信念，但获取的信息不同，而另一些投资者则持有错误的信念。对于所有投资者类型，稳态财富分布都呈现出厚尾特征，其厚度取决于投资组合回报相对于总体市场的高阶矩。总体稳态财富分布的上尾由尾部最厚的群体占据。我证明，这个群体要么是拥有无支配信息集的理性群体，要么是持有错误信念的群体，尽管后者获得的预期回报最低。为了解释观察到的财富集中程度，只需某些投资者群体相对于总体经济每年获得 0.89% 的预期超额回报即可——这与对冲基金和私募股权基金产生的风险调整后回报及其在美国超级富豪中的投资组合份额一致。模型的校准匹配了 Fagereng 等人（2020）记录的挪威家庭平均回报分布。

records.title_en: Classical matching via network formation
records.title_cn: 通过网络形成的经典匹配
records.abstract_en: Despite addressing similar underlying questions, the literatures on network formation and matching have evolved more or less independently. This paper offers a common framework, studying a general model of network formation without externalities—equivalently, a one-sided many-to-many matching model. I give conditions for the existence and uniqueness of stable graphs, I prove a rural hospital theorem, and I highlight a link-by-link conflict of interest across different stable graphs. Special cases contain and extend classic results for the roommate problem and two-sided matching markets. An iterated deletion algorithm adapted from Gutin et al. (2023) furnishes a crucial tool, reducing network formation games to a normal form with helpful properties.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管解决了类似的根本问题，但有关网络形成和匹配的文献或多或少是独立发展的。本文提供了一个通用框架，研究一种没有外部性的网络形成的一般模型——相当于一种单方面的多对多匹配模型。我给出了稳定图的存在性和唯一性的条件，证明了乡村医院定理，并强调了不同稳定图之间逐个链接的利益冲突。特殊情况包含并扩展了室友问题和双边匹配市场的经典结果。改编自 Gutin 等人的迭代删除算法。 (2023) 提供了一个重要的工具，将网络形成博弈简化为具有有用属性的正常形式。

records.title_en: Time use and heterogeneous markups
records.title_cn: 时间使用和异构标记
records.abstract_en: We enrich standard models of imperfect competition by allowing consumer demand for market goods to depend non-separably on off-market time. Consumers value final consumption experiences that require both market purchases and time, which reshapes demand elasticities through two opposing forces. First, because time is an input, changes in market prices translate only partially into changes in the cost of an experience and second, households can substitute time for market purchases in response to price variation. We show how these forces alter the mapping from markups to welfare by distinguishing between markups and a holistic counterpart that accounts for the time cost of consumption. In a monopolistically competitive environment with CES preferences over experiences, firm selection and entry is governed solely by the elasticity of substitution between time use and market purchases, and markup dispersion can be consistent with efficiency when time and market purchases are perfect complements. Extending the analysis to oligopolistic competition, we show that forces that raise markups, like greater market concentration and less competitive conduct, also amplify the gap between the usual and holistic markups.
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过允许消费者对市场商品的需求不可分割地依赖于非市场时间来丰富不完全竞争的标准模型。消费者重视需要市场购买和时间的最终消费体验，这通过两种相反的力量重塑需求弹性。首先，由于时间是一种投入，市场价格的变化只能部分转化为体验成本的变化；其次，家庭可以用时间代替市场购买，以应对价格变化。我们通过区分加成和考虑消费时间成本的整体对应物，展示了这些力量如何改变从加成到福利的映射。在CES优先于体验的垄断竞争环境中，企业选择和进入仅受时间使用和市场购买之间替代弹性的影响，当时间和市场购买完美互补时，加价分散可以与效率保持一致。将分析扩展到寡头垄断竞争，我们发现提高加价的力量，例如更大的市场集中度和竞争性较低的行为，也会放大通常加价和整体加价之间的差距。

records.title_en: When Lasry-Lions meet Krugman: A mean-field game theory of spatial dynamics
records.title_cn: 当拉斯里狮遇到克鲁格曼：空间动力学的平均场博弈论
records.abstract_en: We propose a mean-field game (MFG) approach to study the dynamics of spatial agglomeration in a continuous space-time framework where trade across locations may follow a broad class of static gravity models. Forward-looking intertemporal utility-maximizing agents work and migrate in a two-dimensional geography and face idiosyncratic shocks. Equilibrium wages and prices depend on their common distribution and adjust statically according to the underlying trade model. We first prove existence and uniqueness of the static trade equilibrium. We then prove existence of dynamic equilibria. In the case of a circular economy, we obtain closed-form solutions for small perturbations around the steady state, and we identify the sets of parameters that lead to agglomeration or dispersion. We exploit the MFG structure of the model to explicitly quantify how uncertainty and forward-looking expectations contribute to agglomeration and dispersion. In particular, we show that, regardless of the static trade model, forward-looking expectations always promote agglomeration, but cannot reverse the dominant pattern that would arise under myopic behavior.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种平均场博弈（MFG）方法来研究连续时空框架中空间集聚的动态，其中跨地点的贸易可能遵循广泛的静态重力模型。具有前瞻性的跨期效用最大化主体在二维地理中工作和迁移，并面临特殊的冲击。均衡工资和价格取决于它们的共同分布，并根据基础贸易模型进行静态调整。我们首先证明静态贸易均衡的存在性和唯一性。然后我们证明动态平衡的存在。在循环经济的情况下，我们获得了稳态周围小扰动的封闭式解，并确定了导致聚集或分散的参数集。我们利用模型的 MFG 结构来明确量化不确定性和前瞻性预期如何影响集聚和分散。特别是，我们表明，无论静态贸易模式如何，前瞻性预期总是会促进集聚，但无法扭转短视行为下出现的主导模式。

records.title_en: Robustly optimal voting rule
records.title_cn: 鲁棒最优投票规则
records.abstract_en: We examine optimal strategy-proof voting mechanisms in environments where the designer lacks precise information about the probability distribution of individual utility profiles. This uncertainty over the true distribution is represented by a set of multiple distributions, and the designer evaluates mechanisms using either the worst-case utility sum or worst-case regret. Departing from the existing literature, we do not assume that utility functions are single-peaked or that the set of possible utility functions is maximally rich. In this setting, we show that the median voter rule is the unique optimal mechanism under both criteria. Our result provides a new justification for this well-known mechanism from a welfare perspective.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在设计者缺乏有关个体效用分布概率分布的精确信息的环境中研究最佳的策略验证投票机制。真实分布的这种不确定性由一组多重分布表示，设计者使用最坏情况效用总和或最坏情况遗憾来评估机制。与现有文献不同，我们并不假设效用函数是单峰的，或者可能的效用函数集是最丰富的。在这种情况下，我们表明中位选民规则是这两个标准下唯一的最优机制。我们的结果从福利角度为这一众所周知的机制提供了新的理由。

records.title_en: Minimum price equilibrium in the assignment market: Structural properties and the Serial Vickrey mechanism
records.title_cn: 分配市场中的最低价格均衡：结构性质与序列维克里机制
records.abstract_en: We study an assignment market where multiple heterogeneous objects are sold to unit-demand agents who have general preferences that account for income effects and market frictions. The minimum price equilibrium (MPE) is one of the most important equilibrium concepts in such settings, as it demonstrates the possibility of designing efficient and strategy-proof mechanisms. Nevertheless, none of the well-known auction mechanisms that find the MPE in quasilinear settings can identify or even approximate MPEs for general preferences. We establish novel structural properties of MPEs and use these properties as the foundation to design a “Serial Vickrey (SV) mechanism.” The SV mechanism finds an MPE for general preferences through a finite number of indifference prices reported by the agents, each of which represents their willingness to pay for a target object based on their tentatively assigned bundle. Furthermore, the SV mechanism also has desirable dynamic incentive properties.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个分配市场，其中多个异质物品被出售给具有单位需求的代理人，这些代理人拥有考虑收入效应和市场摩擦的一般偏好。最低价格均衡（MPE）是此类设置中最重要的均衡概念之一，因为它展示了设计有效且策略-proof机制的可能性。然而，在拟线性设置中，没有一种众所周知的拍卖机制能够识别甚至近似一般偏好的MPE。我们建立了MPE的新结构性质，并将这些性质作为设计“序列维克里（SV）机制”的基础。SV机制通过代理人报告的有限数量的无差异价格来找到一般偏好的MPE，每个价格代表他们基于暂定分配束对目标物品的支付意愿。此外，SV机制还具有理想的动态激励性质。

records.title_en: On the efficiency of runnable banking arrangements
records.title_cn: 论可挤兑银行安排的效率
records.abstract_en: Financial arrangements involving illiquid assets financed by liquid liabilities are often viewed as inherently runnable. Diamond and Dybvig (1983) show that this is true when risk-sharing arrangements are not optimally designed. Peck and Shell (2003) and Ennis and Keister (2009, 2016), however, demonstrate that runnable banking arrangements can be constrained-efficient when liquidity demand is uncertain and withdrawals must be processed on a first-come, first-served basis. We show that this insight extends to environments in which redemptions are not subject to a sequential service constraint. Instead, increasing returns to scale in banking-consistent with empirical evidence-can generate regions of the parameter space in which the constrained-efficient allocation is runnable. Runnable banking arrangements can be constrained-efficient when the minimum scale required to realize economies of scale is difficult to attain during large redemption events, when the penalty for failing to achieve scale is small, and when the likelihood of a coordinated run is low
records.abstract_cn: 涉及以流动性负债融资的非流动性资产的金融安排通常被视为本质上可挤兑的。Diamond和Dybvig（1983）表明，当风险分担安排未得到最优设计时，情况确实如此。然而，Peck和Shell（2003）以及Ennis和Keister（2009，2016）证明，当流动性需求不确定且取款必须按先到先得的基础处理时，可挤兑银行安排可以是约束有效的。我们表明，这一见解扩展到赎回不受顺序服务约束的环境中。相反，银行业中的规模报酬递增——与经验证据一致——可以产生参数空间中的区域，在这些区域中，约束有效配置是可挤兑的。当实现规模经济所需的最小规模在大规模赎回事件中难以达到时，当未能达到规模的惩罚较小时，以及当协调挤兑的可能性较低时，可挤兑银行安排可以是约束有效的。

records.title_en: On preference for simplicity and probability weighting
records.title_cn: 关于对简单性和概率加权的偏好
records.abstract_en: Complexity aversion in choice under risk is well documented. One of its main behavioral effects is the event-splitting effect. It captures how the value of a lottery changes when one prize is split into two prizes, each with half the original probability. We weaken independence and continuity to accommodate the event-splitting effect. The resulting preferences admit either an expected utility representation with an additive entropy cost of complexity or a power-weighted expected utility representation in which probabilities are weighted by a power function. The model also provides behavioral foundations for logit choice.
records.abstract_cn: 在风险下选择复杂性的厌恶是有据可查的。其主要行为效应之一是事件分裂效应。它捕捉到当一个奖品被分成两个奖品（每个奖品的概率是原始概率的一半）时，彩票价值如何变化。我们削弱独立性和连续性以适应事件分裂效应。由此产生的偏好允许具有复杂性的加性熵成本的预期效用表示或功率加权的预期效用表示，其中概率由幂函数加权。该模型还为 Logit 选择提供行为基础。

records.title_en: Managing persuasion robustly: The optimality of quota rules
records.title_cn: 强有力的说服管理：配额规则的最优性
records.abstract_en: We study a sender-receiver game in which the receiver can commit to a decision rule before the sender determines the information policy. We ask how the receiver should commit, in advance, to a rule that maps the information of the sender into decisions-when the receiver knows neither the sender’s true preferences nor the full range of information the sender could supply. To handle this dual uncertainty, we adopt a unified robust framework that nests max-min utility, min-max regret, and min-max competitive ratio as special cases. Across all criteria, the same answer emerges: the optimal rule is always a quota rule.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了发送者-接收者博弈，其中接收者可以在发送者确定信息策略之前承诺决策规则。我们询问接收者应如何提前遵守将发送者的信息映射到决策中的规则——当接收者既不知道发送者的真实偏好也不知道发送者可以提供的全部信息时。为了处理这种双重不确定性，我们采用了一个统一的稳健框架，将最大-最小效用、最小-最大遗憾和最小-最大竞争比作为特殊情况。在所有标准中，都会出现相同的答案：最佳规则始终是配额规则。

records.title_en: Informational inertia and the Taylor principle
records.title_cn: 信息惯性和泰勒原理
records.abstract_en: The Taylor principle, a more than one-for-one reaction of the nominal interest rate to inflation, is a central tenet of monetary policy to rule out self-fulfilling equilibria. The standard sticky-price model only holds this principle as a sufficient determinacy bound, with substitutes such as output-gap targeting available. We show that if the long-run Phillips curve is vertical, the Taylor principle is necessary and no amount of output-gap, output-growth, or forecast targeting can substitute for the vigorous response to inflation it prescribes. Sticky price models report determinacy bounds as generically model-dependent, nonlinear functions of model parameters. We find that models with vertical long-run Phillips curves share the same determinacy bounds despite differing short-run tradeoffs. These bounds are more conservative, placing tighter restrictions on monetary policy, and more robust, being independent of model-specific parameters and depending solely on monetary policy’s reaction to current inflation.
records.abstract_cn: 泰勒原则是名义利率对通货膨胀的一对一反应，是货币政策排除自我实现均衡的核心原则。标准粘性价格模型仅将此原则视为足够的确定性界限，并可使用产出缺口目标等替代品。我们表明，如果长期菲利普斯曲线是垂直的，那么泰勒原则是必要的，并且任何产出缺口、产出增长或预测目标都不能取代它所规定的对通货膨胀的积极反应。粘性价格模型将确定性界限报告为模型参数的一般依赖于模型的非线性函数。我们发现，尽管短期权衡不同，但具有垂直长期菲利普斯曲线的模型具有相同的确定性界限。这些界限更加保守，对货币政策施加更严格的限制，并且更加稳健，独立于模型特定参数，仅取决于货币政策对当前通胀的反应。

records.title_en: Government trading and efficiency in imperfectly competitive financial markets
records.title_cn: 不完全竞争金融市场中的政府交易和效率
records.abstract_en: We analyze how public asset purchases affect liquidity, risk sharing and intertemporal smoothing in imperfectly competitive financial markets. Even “neutral” policies, such as budget-balanced trades of risk-free debt, affect liquidity and trading efficiency. Public debt purchases worsen liquidity and risk sharing by increasing price impact, while debt sales improve risk sharing but distort intertemporal trade. “Expansionary” quantitative easing policies can thus reduce trading efficiency. We also derive quantity-based trading rules for optimal public portfolio management. These call for policy to equalize weighted measures of public and private price impact.
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析公共资产购买如何影响不完全竞争的金融市场中的流动性、风险分担和跨期平滑。即使是“中性”政策，例如无风险债务的预算平衡交易，也会影响流动性和交易效率。公共债务购买会增加价格影响，从而恶化流动性和风险分担，而债务出售则改善风险分担，但会扭曲跨期贸易。 “扩张性”量化宽松政策可能会降低交易效率。我们还推导出基于数量的交易规则，以实现最佳的公共投资组合管理。这些要求政策平衡公共和私人价格影响的加权衡量标准。

records.title_en: When can less be more? Inducing dealer responses in RFQ platforms
records.title_cn: 什么时候可以少即是多？在询价平台中诱导经销商响应
records.abstract_en: We show in a model of RFQ trading that customers may admit only a few dealers, even when more are available, to induce maximum liquidity supply—“less can be more.” The number of admitted dealers is pinned down by a competition elasticity, shaped by dealers’ cost to respond to RFQs. For example, higher search (operating) costs increase (reduce) admitted dealers. A social planner would mandate even fewer dealers than the market outcome, because customers induce excessive dealer competition. The model predicts endogenous market power, yields implications for regulation and design of electronic platforms, and speaks to customer-dealer interactions under market stress.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在询价交易模型中表明，即使有更多交易商，客户也可能只接纳少数交易商，以诱导最大的流动性供应——“越少越好”。获准经销商的数量受到竞争弹性的限制，竞争弹性由经销商响应询价的成本决定。例如，较高的搜索（运营）成本会增加（减少）认可的经销商。社会规划者会要求比市场结果更少的经销商，因为客户会引发经销商过度竞争。该模型预测内生市场力量，对电子平台的监管和设计产生影响，并探讨市场压力下客户与经销商的互动。

records.title_en: A folk theorem for finitely repeated games with public monitoring
records.title_cn: 有限重复博弈中公共监督下的民间定理
records.abstract_en: We provide a Folk theorem for finitely repeated games under imperfect public monitoring, under a strengthening of the standard assumptions required for finitely repeated games with perfect monitoring, and of those for discounted repeated games under imperfect public monitoring. Our proof uses standard recursive methods and assumes the existence of a public randomization device. Three counterexamples show in which sense our assumptions are tight.
records.abstract_cn: 我们为不完全公共监督下的有限重复博弈提供了一个民间定理，该定理在加强完美监督下有限重复博弈所需的标准假设以及不完全公共监督下贴现重复博弈所需的标准假设的基础上成立。我们的证明采用标准递归方法，并假设存在一个公共随机化装置。三个反例表明我们的假设在何种意义上是紧致的。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Competition between green and blue hydrogen and indirect network effects
records.title_cn: 绿氢和蓝氢之间的竞争和间接网络效应
records.abstract_en: Whereas hydrogen is currently a marginal energy carrier, the aim of the EU is to trigger low-carbon hydrogen production that covers around 10 percent of EU's energy needs by 2050. If this comes true, it will be an energy revolution. We study competition between green and blue hydrogen using an extended Salop model that encompasses the value chains for hydrogen and CCS. For blue hydrogen, we distinguish between exports of blue hydrogen—natural gas is converted into hydrogen close to the extraction site of natural gas and hydrogen is then transported over a long distance to the hydrogen consumers—and local production of blue hydrogen—natural gas is exported over a long distance and then converted into hydrogen near the hydrogen consumers. We find that mark-ups are highest in the case of exports of blue hydrogen production, which implies that total production of hydrogen, supply of blue hydrogen, and share of plants investing in carbon capture facilities are lower in the case of exports of blue hydrogen than in the case of local production of blue hydrogen. We provide numerical simulations of the alternative market outcomes and the corresponding first-best outcomes and identify policy instruments that should be used to sustain the first-best social outcomes in the cases of exports of blue hydrogen and local production of blue hydrogen.
records.abstract_cn: 鉴于氢目前是一种边际能源载体，欧盟的目标是在10%之前启动低碳氢生产，满足欧盟能源需求的2050左右。如果这成为现实，这将是一场能源革命。我们使用涵盖氢和 CCS 价值链的扩展 Salop 模型研究绿氢和蓝氢之间的竞争。对于蓝氢，我们区分出口蓝氢——天然气在靠近天然气提取地点转化为氢气，然后远距离运输到氢消费者；本地生产蓝氢——天然气长距离出口，然后在氢消费者附近转化为氢气。我们发现，出口蓝氢生产的加价最高，这意味着出口蓝氢的氢总产量、蓝氢供应量以及投资碳捕获设施的工厂比例低于本地生产蓝氢。我们提供了替代市场结果和相应的最佳结果的数值模拟，并确定了在出口蓝氢和本地生产蓝氢的情况下用于维持最佳社会结果的政策工具。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Testing for spillovers in resource conservation: Evidence from a natural field experiment
records.title_cn: 测试资源保护的溢出效应：来自自然现场实验的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper studies whether behavioral interventions designed to promote resource conservation in one domain generate spillovers in another. Using a natural field experiment involving over 2000 residents, we identify the direct and spillover effects of real-time feedback and social comparisons on water and energy consumption. We implement three interventions: two targeting shower use and one targeting air-conditioning use. We find significant reductions in shower use from both water-saving interventions, but no direct effect of the energy-saving intervention on air-conditioning use. For spillovers, we estimate precise null effects of water-saving interventions on air-conditioning use, and of the energy-saving intervention on shower use.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了旨在促进一个领域资源保护的行为干预措施是否会在另一个领域产生溢出效应。通过对2000多名居民进行的自然现场实验，我们确定了实时反馈和社会比较对水和能源消耗的直接和溢出效应。我们实施三项干预措施：两项针对淋浴的使用，一项针对空调的使用。我们发现，两种节水干预措施都显着减少了淋浴的使用，但节能干预措施对空调的使用没有直接影响。对于溢出效应，我们精确估计了节水干预措施对空调使用的零效应，以及节能干预措施对淋浴使用的零效应。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: The regional economic impact of weather shocks: Evidence from Portugal
records.title_cn: 天气冲击对区域经济的影响：来自葡萄牙的证据
records.abstract_en: Weather extremes shape short-run economic activity through both market and nonmarket channels, yet evidence on local consumer-side activity remains limited. Using a municipality-level panel of Portuguese data (2010–2021), we estimate panel VAR and local-projection responses to weather shocks of point-of-sale purchases (a measure of merchant-location transaction activity, not resident household consumption), together with unemployment and house prices. Our central methodological finding is that hourly rather than daily measurement of rainfall variability raises the estimated semi-elasticities by an order of magnitude, suggesting that the existing climate-economy literature systematically understates the importance of high-intensity rainfall. Substantively, the local-projection responses indicate that hourly rainfall volatility raises purchases on impact and reverses the following quarter, consistent with intertemporal reallocation; temperature variability generates a sharp positive impact effect followed by a contraction; and high fire-danger days raise contemporaneous purchases. Unemployment and house prices follow the same patterns more weakly. Regional heterogeneity is substantial, with the Lisbon Metropolitan Area and the Algarve sometimes displaying effects opposite in sign to those in the North.
records.abstract_cn: 极端天气通过市场和非市场渠道影响短期经济活动，但有关当地消费者活动的证据仍然有限。使用葡萄牙的市级面板数据（2010-2021），我们估计面板VAR和当地预测对销售点购买的天气冲击（衡量商家所在地交易活动，而不是居民家庭消费）的反应，以及失业率和房价。我们的主要方法论发现是，每小时而不是每天测量降雨变化将估计的半弹性提高了一个数量级，这表明现有的气候经济文献系统地低估了高强度降雨的重要性。从本质上讲，当地预测响应表明，每小时降雨量波动会增加购买量，并在下个季度出现逆转，这与跨期重新分配一致；温度变化会产生剧烈的积极影响，随后出现收缩；火灾危险高的日子会增加同期购买量。失业率和房价遵循同样的模式，但表现更为疲软。区域异质性很大，里斯本大都市区和阿尔加维有时会表现出与北部相反的效果。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Heterogeneous effects of weather shocks on firm economic performance
records.title_cn: 天气冲击对企业经济绩效的异质影响
records.abstract_en: This paper provides novel firm-level estimates of the economic damages caused by temperature shocks to European firms. I rely on a panel data analysis to show wide heterogeneities in the impact of temperature shocks, which depend on firm characteristics. This paper reveals the importance of micro-level data for quantifying climate damage estimates, as the average relationship between temperature and economic outcomes masks firms’ different susceptibilities to weather shocks. These create both winners and losers, harming less productive firms, particularly those in warmer regions, while benefiting more productive ones. Compared with the pooled marginal effect, the least-productive firms experience negative effects roughly ten times as large, while the most-productive firms experience positive effects roughly three times as large. Additionally, higher temperatures increase exit probability among the least productive firms in warmer regions. I highlight the distributional effects of climate change, and offer insights for adaptation policies.
records.abstract_cn: 本文对温度冲击对欧洲企业造成的经济损失提供了新的企业层面的估计。我依靠面板数据分析来显示温度冲击影响的广泛异质性，这取决于公司特征。本文揭示了微观数据对于量化气候损害估计的重要性，因为温度和经济结果之间的平均关系掩盖了企业对天气冲击的不同敏感性。这些既产生了赢家，也产生了输家，损害了生产力较低的企业，特别是那些位于温暖地区的企业，同时使生产力较高的企业受益。与汇总边际效应相比，生产率最低的企业所经历的负面影响大约是其十倍，而生产率最高的企业所经历的正面影响大约是其三倍。此外，气温升高会增加较温暖地区生产力最低的企业退出的可能性。我强调了气候变化的分配影响，并为适应政策提供了见解。

records.title_en: Cultural origins of preventive health care utilization
records.title_cn: 预防性保健利用的文化起源
records.abstract_en: We examine whether preventive health care uptake varies with cultural background related to patience and risk-taking. We combine individual-level survey data on preventive care use from 27 European countries with country-level preference measures from the Global Preferences Survey. To reduce confounding from institutional and economic correlates of culture, we focus on second-generation immigrants, who were born and currently reside in the same country – and thus face the same health care system and broad economic environment – but differ in inherited cultural background through their parents’ countries of origin. We find that respondents from more patient cultural backgrounds are more likely to use preventive services, while those from more risk-tolerant backgrounds are less likely to do so. These patterns appear across multiple preventive care outcomes.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了预防性医疗保健的接受情况是否因与耐心和冒险相关的文化背景而异。我们将27欧洲国家预防性护理使用的个人层面调查数据与全球偏好调查中的国家层面偏好措施相结合。为了减少文化的制度和经济相关性带来的混淆，我们关注第二代移民，他们出生并目前居住在同一个国家，因此面临相同的医疗保健系统和广泛的经济环境，但通过父母的原籍国继承的文化背景有所不同。我们发现，来自更多患者文化背景的受访者更有可能使用预防性服务，而来自风险承受能力更强背景的受访者则不​​太可能这样做。这些模式出现在多种预防保健结果中。

records.title_en: Income interdependence and informal risk sharing under the shadow of the future
records.title_cn: 未来阴影下的收入相互依赖和非正式风险分担
records.abstract_en: We analyze the effects of income interdependence between two players on risk sharing without commitment in an infinitely repeated game. In theory, the likelihood that an informal risk-sharing agreement is self-enforcing decreases with income correlation due to a higher probability of both players being in the same income state in future periods. We test this prediction in a laboratory setting, using treatments with negative, zero, and positive income correlation. Contrary to expectations, we find the least engagement in risk-sharing activities in the zero-correlation treatment. This surprising result suggests that when incomes are positively correlated, experiencing similar financial outcomes fosters a social bond that enhances the success of informal risk-sharing mechanisms.
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了无限重复博弈中两个参与者之间的收入相互依赖对无承诺风险分担的影响。理论上，非正式风险分担协议自我执行的可能性随着收入相关性的增加而降低，因为双方在未来时期处于相同收入状态的可能性更高。我们在实验室环境中使用收入负相关、零相关和正相关的处理方法测试了这一预测。与预期相反，我们发现零相关处理中风险分担活动的参与最少。这一令人惊讶的结果表明，当收入呈正相关时，经历类似的财务结果会促进社会纽带，从而增强非正式风险分担机制的成功。

records.title_en: Commitment and threats in adversarial bargaining: Insights from a plea bargaining experiment
records.title_cn: 对抗性谈判中的承诺和威胁：辩诉交易实验的见解
records.abstract_en: We study the effect of commitment on threats in adversarial bargaining—situations in which a proposer (prosecutor) demands payment from a responder (defendant) under the threat of conflict if the demand is rejected. We focus on plea bargaining, where a prosecutor files charges against a defendant before a round of plea bargaining. The charges affect payoffs if an agreement is not reached, and the case proceeds to trial. The expected benefit for the prosecutor at trial is maximized at a lower charge than that which maximizes the defendant’s loss. Just before the trial starts, the prosecutor can reduce the charges up to a certain point depending on their level of commitment power. The experimental data show that participants with sufficient commitment power used it to gain bargaining power by overcharging the defendant. However, they do so more conservatively than the theory predicts.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究对抗性讨价还价中承诺对威胁的影响——在这种情况下，提议者（检察官）在要求被拒绝的情况下以冲突威胁要求响应者（被告）付款。我们专注于辩诉交易，即检察官在一轮辩诉交易之前对被告提出指控。如果未达成协议，这些费用将影响赔付，案件将进入审判阶段。检察官在审判中的预期利益以低于最大化被告损失的费用实现最大化。在审判开始前，检察官可以根据其承诺权力的程度将指控减少到一定程度。实验数据表明，拥有足够承诺权的参与者利用其向被告收取过高费用来获得议价能力。然而，他们的做法比理论预测的更为保守。

records.title_en: Promises and Punishment
records.title_cn: 承诺与惩罚
records.abstract_en: We study the effect of communication on beliefs, behavior, and efficiency in the context of trust games with a punishment option, which have the structure of hold-up problems. We apply a novel behavioral motivation, frustration-dependent anger, that links unmet payoff expectations with the willingness to forgo material payoffs to punish others, and we conjecture that communication works through this mechanism to raise expectations about the likelihood of belief-dependent costly punishment and to increase trust, cooperation, and efficiency. Promises drive the effect of communication on beliefs and broken promises lead to costly punishment. In an experiment we allow communication in the form of a single pre-play message. We measure beliefs and our design permits the observation of promises and deception. The results are consistent with the theory.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在带有惩罚选项的信任博弈背景下沟通对信念、行为和效率的影响，这些博弈具有劫持问题的结构。我们应用了一种新颖的行为动机，即依赖于挫折的愤怒，它将未满足的回报期望与放弃物质回报以惩罚他人的意愿联系起来，我们推测，沟通通过这种机制发挥作用，以提高对依赖信念的昂贵惩罚的可能性的期望，并增加信任、合作和效率。承诺会影响沟通对信念的影响，违背承诺会导致代价高昂的惩罚。在实验中，我们允许以单个预播放消息的形式进行通信。我们衡量信念，我们的设计允许遵守承诺和欺骗。结果与理论一致。

records.title_en: Preferences for wealth accumulation and wealth inequality: Experimental evidence
records.title_cn: 财富积累偏好和财富不平等：实验证据
records.abstract_en: Some researchers argue that preferences for wealth accumulation contribute to the long-run stagnation of the Japanese economy. One theoretical implication of such preferences, particularly the assumption that the marginal utility of accumulated wealth has a strictly positive lower bound while that of consumption does not, is a widening of wealth inequality. We experimentally test this theoretical prediction by inducing preferences for wealth accumulation in the laboratory. We find partial support for the prediction: wealth inequality widens when initial inequality is large, but not when it is small. This occurs because high-wealth participants tend to overconsume more than low-wealth participants, partly offsetting the effect of induced preferences for wealth accumulation on inequality dynamics. Providing relative wealth-ranking information has only a limited impact on the widening of wealth inequality.
records.abstract_cn: 一些研究人员认为，对财富积累的偏好导致了日本经济的长期停滞。这种偏好的一个理论含义是财富不平等的扩大，特别是累积财富的边际效用具有严格的正下限而消费的边际效用则没有的假设。我们通过在实验室中诱导财富积累偏好来实验测试这一理论预测。我们发现部分支持这一预测：当初始不平等较大时，财富不平等会扩大，但当初始不平等较小时，财富不平等不会扩大。出现这种情况是因为高财富参与者往往比低财富参与者过度消费，部分抵消了财富积累诱发偏好对不平等动态的影响。提供相对财富排名信息对财富不平等的扩大影响有限。

records.title_en: Can author manipulation of AI referees be welfare improving?
records.title_cn: 作者操纵人工智能裁判可以改善福利吗？
records.abstract_en: This paper asks whether authors’ ability to manipulate AI referees necessarily undermines peer review, or whether it can sometimes improve it. We model a journal in which authors privately know quality, referees choose between costly manual review and cheap AI delegation, and editors may investigate suspicious recommendations. Hidden prompts can force AI to recommend acceptance, but prompt detection is imperfect. With the baseline referee incentives and sequentially rational, non-committed investigation, manual-only review is unsustainable once AI is available, and there is no robust pure-strategy AI-only equilibrium with manipulation. Most notably, under the welfare criterion studied here, prompt injection can be welfare improving on an open set of primitives: in certain monitoring equilibria, manipulation makes positive AI reports more suspicious or more exposed to audit, induces editor investigation, and helps sustain manual review where prompt-free standard inspection would fail. Stronger prompt detection is, therefore, not unconditionally better; within the focal equilibrium menu, it can eliminate a monitoring regime without replacing it with a higher-welfare one.
records.abstract_cn: 本文询问作者操纵人工智能裁判的能力是否必然会破坏同行评审，或者有时是否可以改善同行评审。我们模拟了一本期刊，其中作者私下了解质量，审稿人在昂贵的人工审查和廉价的人工智能授权之间进行选择，编辑可能会调查可疑的建议。隐藏的提示可以迫使人工智能建议接受，但提示检测并不完善。凭借基线裁判激励和顺序理性、非承诺的调查，一旦人工智能可用，仅人工审核是不可持续的，并且不存在稳健的纯策略人工智能平衡与操纵。最值得注意的是，根据这里研究的福利标准，即时注入可以改善一组开放原语的福利：在某些监控平衡中，操纵使积极的人工智能报告更加可疑或更容易受到审计，引发编辑调查，并有助于维持手动审查，而无即时标准检查将失败。因此，更强的及时检测并非无条件地更好；在焦点平衡菜单中，它可以消除一种监控制度，而无需用更高福利的制度取代它。

records.title_en: Universalization and the origins of fiscal capacity
records.title_cn: 普遍化与财政能力的起源
records.abstract_en: This paper proposes a model of tax compliance and fiscal capacity in which citizens partially internalize the consequences of concealment by imagining a world in which a share of the population acted similarly, linking their compliance decisions to the perceived value of public spending. A selfish elite chooses between public goods and private rents, taking compliance as given. In equilibrium, citizens’ moral internalization expands the feasible tax base and induces elites to allocate resources toward provision rather than appropriation. When the value of public spending is uncertain, morality enables credible reform: high-value elites can signal their type through provision, prompting citizens to increase compliance and raising fiscal capacity within the same period. The analysis thus identifies a moral channel through which states may escape low-capacity traps even under weak enforcement.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一个税收遵从与财政能力的模型，其中公民通过想象一部分人口采取类似行为的世界，部分内化了隐瞒的后果，将其遵从决策与公共支出的感知价值联系起来。一个自私的精英阶层在给定遵从水平下，在公共物品与私人租金之间进行选择。在均衡状态下，公民的道德内化扩大了可行的税基，并诱导精英将资源分配向供给而非侵占倾斜。当公共支出的价值不确定时，道德能够促成可信的改革：高价值精英可以通过供给来传递其类型信号，促使公民提高遵从度，并在同一时期内提升财政能力。因此，分析识别了一种道德渠道，通过该渠道，即使在执法薄弱的情况下，国家也可能摆脱低能力陷阱。

records.title_en: Market selection of strategic thinking types
records.title_cn: 战略思维类型的市场选择
records.abstract_en: Markets are often used to allocate decision-making, from selecting voting rights of shareholders to hiring workers in the gig economy. We study how market selection can influence the composition of strategic thinking types in strategic interactions. Using auctions as the selection mechanism, we demonstrate that after-market decisions in the p-Beauty Contest Game can result in either higher or lower numbers, depending on the incentives. Furthermore, we pinpoint the cause of differences to the market selection of strategic thinking types, rather than the decision-maker altering behaviour due to beliefs about the selection of other players. This highlights the role of institutional factors in determining “who plays the game”.
records.abstract_cn: 市场经常被用来分配决策，从选择股东的投票权到在零工经济中雇用工人。我们研究市场选择如何影响战略互动中战略思维类型的构成。使用拍卖作为选择机制，我们证明了 p-选美比赛游戏中的售后决策可能会导致更高或更低的数字，具体取决于激励措施。此外，我们指出战略思维类型的市场选择差异的原因，而不是决策者由于对其他参与者的选择的信念而改变行为。这凸显了制度因素在决定“谁玩游戏”方面的作用。

records.title_en: Sexual identity, industrial segregation and earnings
records.title_cn: 性别认同、行业隔离和收入
records.abstract_en: Using longitudinal data from the UK, we study the role of industrial segregation for sexual identity-based pay disparities, while controlling for fixed unobserved heterogeneity. We show that industries that have a greater proportion of sexual minorities pay their male employees less. This is of an order of magnitude of a 0.6% marginal reduction in earnings as industrial representation of sexual minorities increases by 1 percent. This compares to an equivalent marginal figure for occupational segregation of approximately 0.9%. In contrast, there is a protective element present for females in the public sector who benefit from a within industry premium to locating in industries with greater LGB representation. However, such effects do not remove the substantial wage penalty faced by gay men, and by lesbian women in the private sector.
records.abstract_cn: 使用英国的纵向数据，我们研究了行业隔离对基于性别身份的薪酬差异的作用，同时控制了固定的未观察到的异质性。我们发现，性少数群体比例较高的行业，其男性员工的薪酬较低。随着性少数群体的工业代表性增加 0.6%，收入边际减少了 1% 个数量级。相比之下，职业隔离的同等边际数字约为0.9%。相比之下，公共部门的女性存在一种保护因素，她们可以从行业内溢价中受益，而不是进入 LGB 代表性较高的行业。然而，这种影响并不能消除私营部门中男同性恋者和女同性恋者面临的巨额工资惩罚。

records.title_en: Big push to export: Unintended consequences of China’s domestic regulations in digital game sector
records.title_cn: 大力推动出口：中国数字游戏行业国内法规的意外后果
records.abstract_en: We document that China’s 2018 domestic regulations, which suppressed the future growth potential of its game app market, unintentionally triggered an immediate and significant export expansion in this sector. This expansion was largely accounted for by apps already established in foreign markets, and was significantly stronger among high-quality firms. To rationalize these patterns, we develop and calibrate a dynamic model featuring customer accumulation under capacity constraints. In response to the regulatory shocks, firms proactively reallocate resources toward foreign markets, with higher-quality firms exhibiting a stronger reallocation response. This proactive behavior further amplifies the welfare losses borne by domestic consumers.
records.abstract_cn: 我们记录到，中国2018国内法规抑制了游戏应用市场的未来增长潜力，无意中引发了该行业的立即而显着的出口扩张。这种扩张主要是由国外市场上已经建立的应用程序造成的，并且在高质量公司中表现得更为强劲。为了使这些模式合理化，我们开发并校准了一个动态模型，该模型以容量限制下的客户积累为特征。为应对监管冲击，企业主动向国外市场重新配置资源，质量较高的企业表现出更强的重新配置反应。这种主动行为进一步放大了国内消费者所承受的福利损失。

records.title_en: A strategic analysis of narcoterrorism: counterterrorism, terrorist extortion, and illicit drug trafficking
records.title_cn: 毒品恐怖主义的战略分析：反恐、恐怖勒索和非法贩毒
records.abstract_en: The paper presents a novel strategic analysis of narcoterrorism where a weak developing country’s terrorist group extorts home drug farmers to finance terror attacks. A developed country’s counterterror actions are motivated by the harm its residents endure from those attacks. The developed country’s counterterrorism involves efforts to destroy the drug crop abroad. The analysis begins with the drug price being exogenously fixed, followed by a “large-country case’’ with a market-determined drug price. The extension introduces a fourth participant, consisting of the developed country’s consumers whose purchases determine the drug demand. A subsequent extension allows for two drug-exporting countries along with their resident terrorist groups. Now, the drug price depends on terrorists’ extortion rates and the developed country’s counterterrorism associated with the two drug-exporting countries. With the last extension, novel drug-based counterterror transfers of terrorism occur between the drug-producing countries. For alternative scenarios, we show the key influence of the elasticity of the farmers’ counterterror resilience on the extortion rate and terrorism level.
records.abstract_cn: 该论文对毒品恐怖主义进行了新颖的战略分析，其中一个弱小的发展中国家的恐怖组织勒索国内毒贩以资助恐怖袭击。发达国家的反恐行动是由于其居民因这些袭击而遭受的伤害。发达国家的反恐行动包括摧毁国外的毒品作物。分析从外生固定药品价格开始，然后是由市场决定药品价格的“大国案例”。扩展引入了第四个参与者，即发达国家的消费者，其购买量决定了药品需求。随后的扩展允许两个毒品出口国及其常驻恐怖组织。现在，药品价格取决于恐怖分子的勒索率以及发达国家与两个毒品出口国相关的反恐能力。最后一次扩展，以新型毒品为基础的新型毒品对于其他情景，我们展示了农民反恐弹性对勒索率和恐怖主义水平的关键影响。

records.title_en: Measuring the Sources of Taste-Based Discrimination Using List Experiments
records.title_cn: 利用列表实验测量基于偏好的歧视来源
records.abstract_en: This study uses a large, nationally representative online survey in Chile comparing double list experiments, which reduce social desirability bias, with direct questions on attitudes among supervisors, co-workers, and customers toward gay individuals. Respondents underreported their discomfort with gay individuals by 15-23 percentage points, with the largest bias and lowest comfort levels observed when asked about supervising gay employees. These patterns were mirrored in incentivized donation behavior: individuals who refused to donate in a lottery to LGBTQ-related nonprofits reported lower comfort levels and exhibited greater misreporting. Finally, respondents consistently underestimated the broader societal support for gay employees and co-workers.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究利用智利一项大规模、具有全国代表性的在线调查，比较了双重列表实验（可减少社会期望偏差）与直接询问主管、同事和顾客对同性恋者态度的问题。受访者对其与同性恋者相处的不适感低报了15-23个百分点，其中在询问关于监督同性恋员工时，偏差最大且舒适度最低。这些模式在激励性捐赠行为中得到了反映：在彩票中拒绝向LGBTQ相关非营利组织捐赠的个人报告了较低的舒适度，并表现出更大的误报。最后，受访者一致低估了社会对同性恋员工和同事的更广泛支持。

records.title_en: The effect of network degree on bargaining: Experimental evidence from the field
records.title_cn: 网络度对讨价还价的影响：来自田野的实验证据
records.abstract_en: We conduct an artefactual field experiment in real-existing trade networks to analyze how individual network degree affects bargaining demands and outcomes. We combine data from a bilateral bargaining experiment with data of trade networks in 24 villages in Uganda. To identify the effect of individual degree in the village trade network we experimentally vary the disclosure of participants’ identities in a bargaining pair. We state hypotheses on how degree will affect behavior and find partial support for them. Specifically, we observe that individual degree affects bargaining demands in the predicted direction when one of the bargainers is informed about the network positions but not when either no or both sides are informed. Moreover, network degree affects the likelihood of agreements and earnings, irrespective of the knowledge of the network positions of bargaining partners.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在真实存在的贸易网络中开展了一项人工田野实验，以分析个体网络度如何影响讨价还价的要求和结果。我们将双边讨价还价实验的数据与乌干达24个村庄的贸易网络数据相结合。为了识别个体在村庄贸易网络中度的效应，我们在实验中变化了讨价还价对中参与者身份的披露情况。我们提出了关于度如何影响行为的假设，并发现了部分支持。具体而言，我们观察到，当讨价还价者中有一方被告知网络位置时，个体度以预测的方向影响讨价还价要求，但当双方均未被告知或双方均被告知时则不然。此外，网络度影响达成协议的可能性和收益，无论讨价还价伙伴的网络位置是否被知晓。

records.title_en: The demographic impact of weather disasters: Evidence from extreme rainfall exposure in rural China
records.title_cn: 天气灾害对人口的影响：来自中国农村极端降雨的证据
records.abstract_en: Using monthly rainfall data, we study the demographic consequences of extreme rainfall variability, focusing on extreme dry and wet events in rural China. We find that both types of extreme rainfall events increase fertility, with a stronger response for male births, between 1990 and 1999. More than a decade later, children who were exposed to extreme rainfall events in utero, especially extreme wet events, attain fewer years of schooling than unexposed cohorts. The second trimester of pregnancy emerges as the critical exposure window, with shocks during this period generating the largest negative effects on adult educational outcomes. Examining potential mechanisms, we show that extreme rainfall events reduce household income and increase child mortality. These results highlight the persistent demographic impacts of extreme weather shocks.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用每月降雨量数据，研究极端降雨量变化对人口的影响，重点关注中国农村的极端干旱和潮湿事件。我们发现，在1990和1999之间，两种类型的极端降雨事件都会增加生育率，对男性出生的反应更强。十多年后，在子宫内暴露于极端降雨事件（尤其是极端潮湿事件）的儿童的受教育年限比未暴露于极端降雨事件的儿童要少。妊娠中期是关键的暴露窗口，这一时期的冲击对成人教育成果产生最大的负面影响。通过研究潜在的机制，我们发现极端降雨事件会减少家庭收入并增加儿童死亡率。这些结果凸显了极端天气冲击对人口的持续影响。

records.title_en: Preferences for redistribution policies among politicians and citizens
records.title_cn: 政治家和公民对再分配政策的偏好
records.abstract_en: This paper compares the “mental maps” of redistribution among politicians and citizens across seven parliaments, using original in-person surveys of sitting MPs and nationally representative citizen samples. Fairness beliefs and ideology are the strongest correlates of support for redistribution in both groups, while misperceptions of wealth concentration matter for citizens but much less for politicians. A central finding is that politicians hold markedly more polarized views on redistribution than citizens, including within the same party families. We also find systematic elite-voter gaps: left MPs are more supportive than their voters (notably on inheritance taxation), whereas right/liberal MPs are less supportive than theirs. These patterns point to a representation concern and to a narrower bargaining space among elites than in the electorate.
records.abstract_cn: 本文使用对现任议员和具有全国代表性的公民样本进行的原始现场调查，比较了七个议会政治家和公民之间重新分配的“心理地图”。在这两个群体中，公平信念和意识形态是支持再分配的最强相关因素，而对财富集中的误解对公民来说很重要，但对政客来说就更不用说了。一个核心发现是，政客对再分配的看法明显比公民更加两极分化，包括同一党派内部的公民。我们还发现了系统性的精英选民差距：左翼议员比他们的选民更支持（特别是在遗产税方面），而右翼/自由派议员则比他们的选民支持率低。这些模式表明了对代表权的担忧，以及精英之间的讨价还价空间比选民更窄。

records.title_en: Within-group inequality and caste-based crimes in India
records.title_cn: 印度的群体内不平等和基于种姓的犯罪
records.abstract_en: We examine how within-group inequality, by influencing the group bias of state institutions, affects the cost-benefit calculus of individuals engaging in identity-assertive behaviour, that results in police complaints regarding hate crimes. We develop a two-stage contest model of between-group conflict, where the relative influence of a group over institutions, determined by an initial contest, affects subsequent hierarchy-establishing interaction between individuals belonging to opposing groups. Applying this model to caste conflict in India, we find that greater inequality among non-Scheduled Caste and non-Scheduled Tribe (non-SC/ST) Hindus reduces the registered rate of crimes against SCs by non-SC/ST Hindus, and the rate at which such registered crimes lead to conviction. Using state-level annual crime and household consumption data over 2005–2021, we find empirical support for these hypotheses. Our analysis suggests that greater equality within dominant groups might reduce institution-capture by them and thereby improve both reporting and punishment of aggression against marginalized groups.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究群体内的不平等如何通过影响国家机构的群体偏见，影响从事身份维护行为的个人的成本效益计算，从而导致警方对仇恨犯罪的投诉。我们开发了一种群体间冲突的两阶段竞争模型，其中由初始竞争决定的群体对机构的相对影响力会影响随后属于对立群体的个人之间建立等级制度的互动。将这一模型应用于印度的种姓冲突，我们发现非在册种姓和非在册部落（非在册种姓/在册部落）印度教徒之间更大的不平等降低了非在册种姓/在册部落印度教徒针对在册种姓的犯罪登记率，以及此类登记犯罪导致定罪的比率。使用2005-2021期间州级年度犯罪和家庭消费数据，我们找到了这些假设的实证支持。我们的分析表明，主导群体内部更大的平等可能会减少他们的制度束缚，从而改善对边缘群体的侵犯的报告和惩罚。

records.title_en: (Un)equal and safe: How distributional and defense information shape fuel tax support?
records.title_cn: （不）平等和安全：分配和国防信息如何影响燃油税支持？
records.abstract_en: Carbon taxation is one of the most effective tools for reducing emissions, but it often faces public resistance due to concerns about fairness, distributional impacts, and the use of revenue. Experimental evidence on how these factors shape tax acceptance remains limited, particularly outside North America and Western Europe. This study examines how information emphasizing the progressive features of a fuel tax—a proxy for carbon taxation—affects perceptions of fairness and tax acceptance. It also investigates, for the first time, how allocating tax revenue to national defense, at a time when this issue is highly salient, influences tax acceptance. Drawing on Lithuania’s 2025 fuel tax increase, which was partially earmarked for defense spending, we conducted an online survey experiment (N = 2553). Respondents were assigned to one of three conditions: (1) information on the tax’s distributional effects, emphasizing its progressiveness; (2) the same information plus a reminder about revenue allocation to defense; or (3) no information. Providing distributional information, both on its own and in combination with a reminder that revenues would be allocated to defense spending, increased perceived fairness and self-reported support for the tax. Moreover, the combined treatment reduced opposition to the tax. The defense-earmarking reminder also made an independent contribution to reducing opposition. Overall, the results suggest that both distributional considerations and the intended use of revenues shape public acceptance of the policy.
records.abstract_cn: 碳税是减少排放的最有效工具之一，但由于对公平性、分配影响和收入使用的担忧，它经常面临公众的抵制。关于这些因素如何影响税收接受度的实验证据仍然有限，特别是在北美和西欧以外的地区。本研究探讨了强调燃油税（碳税的替代品）累进特征的信息如何影响公平性和税收接受度的看法。它还首次调查了在这个问题非常突出的情况下，将税收收入分配给国防会如何影响税收接受度。利用立陶宛2025燃油税的增加（部分指定用于国防开支），我们进行了在线调查实验（N = 2553）。受访者被分配到以下三个条件之一：（1）有关税收分配影响的信息，强调其累进性； (2)相同的信息加上关于国防收入分配的提醒；或 (3) 无信息。提供分配信息，既可以单独提供，也可以结合提醒收入将分配给国防支出、增加感知公平性和自我报告的税收支持。此外，综合待遇减少了对税收的反对。国防专项提醒也为减少反对派做出了独立贡献。总体而言，结果表明，分配考虑因素和收入的预期用途都会影响公众对政策的接受程度。

records.title_en: Social expectations and norm nudging in anti-coordination problems: An El Farol Bar Game experiment
records.title_cn: 反协调问题中的社会期望和规范推动：El Farol 酒吧游戏实验
records.abstract_en: Norm nudging interventions seek to influence behavior by shaping what individuals expect others to do (empirical expectations) or regard as appropriate (normative expectations). We study how such interventions operate in an anonymous anti-coordination problem, using an online El Farol Bar Game experiment composed of two studies. Study 1 elicits social expectations (empirical and normative) and personal normative beliefs before subjects make their decision in the El Farol Bar Game. Study 2 implements norm nudges by providing participants with pre-decision messages based on the social expectations elicited in Study 1. Results show that subjects conform not only to their empirical expectations, but also to their personal normative beliefs. Normative expectations exert weaker and less consistent effects. Moreover, norm nudging interventions primarily induce prudence by reducing behavior that jeopardizes social welfare.
records.abstract_cn: 规范推动干预旨在通过塑造个人期望他人做什么（经验期望）或认为适当的事情（规范期望）来影响行为。我们使用由两项研究组成的在线 El Farol 酒吧游戏实验来研究此类干预措施如何在匿名反协调问题中发挥作用。研究1在受试者在 El Farol 酒吧游戏中做出决定之前引发社会期望（经验和规范）和个人规范信念。研究2根据研究1中得出的社会期望向参与者提供决策前信息，从而实施规范助推。结果表明，受试者不仅符合他们的经验期望，而且符合他们个人的规范信念。规范预期的影响较弱且不太一致。此外，规范推动干预措施主要通过减少危害社会福利的行为来诱导谨慎。

records.title_en: Climate shocks, attitudes towards intimate partner violence, and the protective role of climate-resilience projects
records.title_cn: 气候冲击、对亲密伴侣暴力的态度以及气候适应项目的保护作用
records.abstract_en: This study investigates the impact of climate change on intimate partner violence attitudes in Bangladesh and shows that policy can mitigate much, if not all, of the harmful consequences of climate shocks on women. Utilizing a novel dataset linking geo-referenced meteorological data with information on women’s attitudes, we find that dry shocks increase tolerance for intimate partner violence among women in poor and agriculture-dependent communities, with suggestive evidence that this happens due to the erosion of women’s outside options. Distributed-lag estimates show that these effects persist beyond the immediate period of exposure, consistent with a gradual weakening of women’s fallback positions rather than a purely short-run stress-induced or backlash response. Climate resilience projects funded by the Bangladesh Climate Change Trust (BCCT), a domestic climate fund, mitigate the negative impacts of dry shocks, highlighting the significant role of such initiatives in generating positive ameliorative spillover effects. Remotely sensed data on land use and crop-yield indicators reveal that these projects protect agriculture during dry shocks, especially in the rainfed Aman season, thus providing a credible test of the importance of the agricultural transmission channel and the pathway through which such projects buffer climate shocks. Our findings underline the crucial role of targeted policies in fostering climate adaptation.
records.abstract_cn: 这项研究调查了气候变化对孟加拉国亲密伴侣暴力态度的影响，并表明政策可以减轻气候冲击对妇女造成的有害后果，即使不是全部。利用将地理参考气象数据与妇女态度信息联系起来的新颖数据集，我们发现，干旱冲击增加了贫困和依赖农业的社区妇女对亲密伴侣暴力的容忍度，有暗示性证据表明，这种情况的发生是由于妇女的外部选择受到侵蚀。分布式滞后估计表明，这些影响在直接暴露期之后仍然持续存在，这与女性后备地位的逐渐削弱一致，而不是纯粹的短期压力引起或强烈反应。由国内气候基金孟加拉国气候变化信托基金 (BCCT) 资助的气候复原力项目减轻了干旱冲击的负面影响，凸显了此类举措在产生积极的改善溢出效应方面的重要作用。土地利用和作物产量指标的遥感数据表明，这些项目在干旱冲击期间保护了农业，特别是在雨养的阿曼季节，从而为农业传输渠道的重要性以及此类项目缓冲气候冲击的途径提供了可靠的检验。我们的研究结果强调了有针对性的政策在促进气候适应方面的关键作用。

records.title_en: Give enough or not at all
records.title_cn: 给足够或根本不给
records.abstract_en: We investigate prosocial preferences in contexts where giving involves small amounts. Focusing on the lower bound of generosity, we propose an asymmetry: givers may prefer to give nothing rather than a small amount, whereas receivers prefer receiving a small amount to receiving nothing. Evidence from two survey experiments (N = 1,658), an incentivized laboratory experiment (N = 296), and a field study involving 77 fundraising sessions supports the existence of a reluctance to give small amounts. Our findings further suggest that this reluctance is misaligned with receivers’ preferences and that informing givers that small amounts are acceptable significantly increases the likelihood of giving.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在捐赠金额较小的情况下调查亲社会偏好。着眼于慷慨的下限，我们提出了一种不对称性：给予者可能更愿意什么也不给予而不是少量，而接受者更愿意接受少量而不是什么也不接受。来自两项调查实验 (N = 1,658)、一项激励性实验室实验 (N = 296) 和一项涉及 77 筹款活动的实地研究的证据表明，人们不愿意捐赠少量资金。我们的研究结果进一步表明，这种不情愿与接受者的偏好不一致，并且告知给予者少量的金额是可以接受的会显着增加给予的可能性。

records.title_en: News shocks and seafood exports: Evidence from the Fukushima ALPS-treated water release announcement
records.title_cn: 新闻冲击和海鲜出口：来自福岛 ALPS 处理水释放公告的证据
records.abstract_en: News shocks are often characterized as a form of external uncertainty, which could drive consumer behavior by shaping cognitive processes. However, news coverage often coincides with real-world events, making it difficult to identify whether observed effects are driven by the news itself or by the underlying events. Based on the announcement of the planned release of ALPS-treated water from Fukushima, news concerning future events, this paper identifies the economic consequences of news shocks and incorporates salience theory into international trade. Applying a difference-in-difference method, we find that Pacific Rim countries and regions near Japan experienced a significantly greater decrease in seafood exports than those further away in the post-news period. The negative effects could be attributed to demand-side factors, including consumer sensitivity to news, heightened fear of unknown risks, and a shift toward substitute products.
records.abstract_cn: 新闻冲击通常被认为是外部不确定性的一种形式，它可以通过塑造认知过程来驱动消费者行为。然而，新闻报道往往与现实世界的事件重合，因此很难确定观察到的影响是由新闻本身还是由潜在事件驱动的。本文根据福岛计划排放经过 ALPS 处理的水的公告以及有关未来事件的新闻，识别了新闻冲击的经济后果，并将显着性理论纳入国际贸易。采用双重差分法，我们发现，新闻发布后，靠近日本的环太平洋国家和地区的海鲜出口下降幅度明显大于距离较远的国家和地区。负面影响可能归因于需求方因素，包括消费者对新闻的敏感性、对未知风险的恐惧加剧以及转向替代产品。

records.title_en: Complementarity, congestion and information design in epidemics with strategic social behaviour
records.title_cn: 流行病与战略社会行为的互补性、拥堵性和信息设计
records.abstract_en: In the context of an epidemic where the risk of death post-infection depends on demography and social behaviour, this paper characterises how the degree of congestibility of the social environment and the public/private nature of the available information about health states jointly affect the strategic social distancing of demographically heterogeneous agents. Key result is that the joint presence of congestibility and private information is necessary and sufficient for social-distancing decisions to be strategic complements. Strategic substitutability ensues in every other case. Within the limits of the proposed model, the analysis provides a sound theoretical rationale for the heterogeneity in the results provided by the extant literature on the issue. Implications ensue for optimal information design. First: limiting private information (e.g. by forbidding self-tests) is always socially optimal. Second: if private information cannot be limited, the second-best policy crucially depends on environmental congestibility: with high congestibility, providing the maximum extent of public information (e.g. via mass screening campaigns) is desirable, whereas the converse is true with low congestibility.
records.abstract_cn: 在感染后死亡风险取决于人口统计和社会行为的流行病背景下，本文描述了社会环境的拥挤程度和有关健康状况的可用信息的公共/私人性质如何共同影响人口异质主体的战略社会距离。主要结果是，拥塞性和私人信息的共同存在对于社会疏远决策成为战略补充是必要且充分的。在所有其他情况下都会出现战略替代性。在所提出模型的限制内，该分析为现有文献所提供的结果的异质性提供了合理的理论依据。这对优化信息设计产生了影响。第一：限制私人信息（例如通过禁止自我测试）始终是社会最优的。其次：如果私人信息不能受到限制，那么次佳政策关键取决于环境拥挤度：在拥挤度高的情况下，提供最大程度的公共信息（例如通过大规模筛查活动）是可取的，而在拥挤度低的情况下则相反。

records.title_en: Right-sizing incentives
records.title_cn: 合理设置激励规模
records.abstract_en: This paper presents results from a field experiment in Nigeria in which expectant mothers were offered cash payments of N2500, N4000 or N10000 conditioned on using formal medical care. A secondary intervention provided some mothers with an information signal about their pregnancy risk. We find highly non-linear effects of conditional payments—most of the incentive effect occurs on the extensive margin, with rapidly diminishing returns to incentive size. We also uncover new spillover effects: showing that incentives increase healthcare use in childhood by index children and by other children in the household. We find largely null effects of the information signal.
records.abstract_cn: 本文介绍了在尼日利亚进行的一项现场实验的结果，其中向准妈妈提供 N2500、N4000 或 N10000 的现金支付，条件是使用正规医疗护理。二次干预为一些母亲提供了有关其怀孕风险的信息信号。我们发现有条件支付的高度非线性效应——大部分激励效应发生在外延边际上，激励规模的回报迅速递减。我们还发现了新的溢出效应：表明激励措施增加了目标儿童和家庭中其他儿童在儿童时期的医疗保健使用。我们发现信息信号的总体上没有明显影响。

records.title_en: Non-normal Empirical Bayes prediction of local welfare
records.title_cn: 局部福利的非正态经验贝叶斯预测
records.abstract_en: Estimates of the area- and household idiosyncratic error distributions from household income and consumption regression models across 142 household surveys from 16 different countries, the type of models that underpin poverty maps, points to significant deviations from normality. The poverty mapping approach put forward by Elbers et al. (2003) demonstrates the value of accommodating this non-normality. Unfortunately, their non-parametric estimator for the error distribution functions does not lend itself for Empirical Bayes (EB) prediction. This paper puts forward an approach that accommodates both EB prediction and non-normally distributed errors. Accounting for non-normality in Empirical Best estimation of local welfare is found to increase precision relative to normal-EB estimation. While the gains in precision range between substantial and marginal, it is always positive. Being able to obtain precise local estimates of welfare help governments and development agencies identify and monitor lagging areas and allocate their resources in a more efficient manner.
records.abstract_cn: 来自142不同国家16家庭调查的家庭收入和消费回归模型对地区和家庭特殊误差分布的估计，即支撑贫困图的模型类型，表明与正态性存在显着偏差。 Elbers 等人提出的贫困绘图方法。 (2003) 证明了适应这种非正态性的价值。不幸的是，他们的误差分布函数非参数估计器不适用于经验贝叶斯 (EB) 预测。本文提出了一种同时适应 EB 预测和非正态分布误差的方法。研究发现，相对于正态 EB 估计，在经验最佳估计中考虑非正态性可以提高当地福利的精确度。虽然精度的提高介于显着和边际之间，但它总是积极的。能够获得准确的当地福利估计有助于政府和发展机构识别和监测落后地区并以更有效的方式分配资源。

records.title_en: Local and spillover effects of trade on structural transformation: Evidence from Brazil
records.title_cn: 贸易对结构转型的本地和溢出效应：来自巴西的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates the impact of trade liberalization on structural transformation, leveraging quasi-experimental tariff reductions from Brazil’s 1990s reforms. Building on recent cross-regional macroeconomic literature, we extend the traditional shift-share framework to estimate both local and spatial spillover effects on sectoral employment shares, providing insights into aggregate outcomes. Regions more exposed to tariff reductions experienced a reallocation of employment away from manufacturing and non-tradables and toward primary activities. Consistent with a comparative-advantage channel, the shift toward the primary sector is stronger in regions with higher agricultural potential. Spillover effects — mediated through migration or gravity — partially offset local deindustrialization in manufacturing but amplified declines in non-tradables. These effects persisted over two decades and remained robust to alternative structural transformation hypotheses, concurrent economic shocks, and controls for expenditure exposure. Overall, our findings support theories highlighting comparative advantage as a key driver of trade-induced structural transformation.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用巴西1990改革中的准实验性关税削减，研究了贸易自由化对结构转型的影响。在最近的跨区域宏观经济文献的基础上，我们扩展了传统的转移份额框架，以估计对部门就业份额的本地和空间溢出效应，从而提供对总体结果的见解。更容易受到关税削减影响的地区经历了就业从制造业和非贸易品转向初级活动的重新分配。与比较优势渠道一致，农业潜力较高的地区向第一产业的转变更为强烈。通过移民或重力介导的溢出效应部分抵消了当地制造业的去工业化，但放大了非贸易品的下降。这些影响持续了二十多年，并且对于替代结构转型假设、同时发生的经济冲击和支出风险控制仍然强劲。总体而言，我们的研究结果支持强调比较优势是贸易引发的结构转型关键驱动力的理论。

records.title_en: Government demand and firm growth
records.title_cn: 政府需求与企业增长
records.abstract_en: Public procurement in developing countries accounts for approximately 13% of GDP, offering a significant market opportunity for domestic firms, especially those facing demand constraints. This paper explores the impact of selling to government entities on firm performance in Uganda, leveraging detailed administrative data and an event study methodology that corrects for firm self-selection and heterogeneity in the timing of the treatment. The results reveal that while firms increase their total sales after entering government contracts, they do not see improvements in productivity (measured by value added per worker). Moreover, sales to non-government customers drop sharply. This reallocation effect is persistent. This effect is not observed when firms start to sell to large private-sector buyers. Drawing on an original survey of firms engaged in public procurement, we highlight potential drivers of these dynamics, including capacity constraints and profitability differences between public and private sector sales.
records.abstract_cn: 发展中国家的公共采购约占 GDP 的13%，为国内企业，特别是面临需求限制的企业提供了重要的市场机会。本文利用详细的行政数据和事件研究方法，探讨了向政府实体出售产品对乌干达公司绩效的影响，该方法纠正了公司的自我选择和处理时间的异质性。结果显示，虽然企业在签订政府合同后增加了总销售额，但他们并没有看到生产率的提高（以每个工人的增加值来衡量）。此外，对非政府客户的销售额急剧下降。这种重新分配效应是持久的。当公司开始向大型私营部门买家出售产品时，不会观察到这种效应。根据对从事公共采购的公司的原始调查，我们强调了这些动态的潜在驱动因素，包括能力限制以及公共和私营部门销售之间的盈利能力差异。

records.title_en: Texting parents about early child development: Behavioral changes and unintended social effects
records.title_cn: 向父母发送儿童早期发展短信：行为变化与非预期的社会效应
records.abstract_en: Parenting interventions have the potential to improve early childhood development. Text messages are considered a promising channel to diffuse parenting information at low cost. This paper tests whether sending text messages about parenting practices impacts early childhood development. Households in rural Nicaragua were randomly assigned to receive messages about nutrition, health, stimulation and the home environment. The intervention led to significant changes in self-reported parenting practices. However, it did not improve children’s cognitive development. When local opinion leaders were randomly exposed to the same text message intervention, parental investments declined and children’s outcomes deteriorated. These negative effects were strongest for children of the least educated caregivers. Since interactions between parents and leaders about child development also decreased, the negative effects may have resulted from a crowding-out of efforts by local leaders.
records.abstract_cn: 育儿干预有可能改善儿童早期发展。短信被认为是一种以低成本传播育儿信息的有前景的渠道。本文测试了发送有关育儿实践的短信是否会影响儿童早期发展。尼加拉瓜农村的家庭被随机分配接收有关营养、健康、刺激和家庭环境的信息。干预导致自我报告的育儿实践发生重大变化。然而，它并没有改善儿童的认知发展。当当地意见领袖随机接受相同的短信干预时，父母的投资就会下降，孩子的成绩也会恶化。这些负面影响对于受教育程度最低的照顾者的孩子来说最为严重。由于家长和领导之间关于儿童发展的互动也减少了，负面影响可能是由于当地领导的努力被挤出而造成的。

records.title_en: Housing wealth, family relationship and mental health: Evidence from China
records.title_cn: 住房财富、家庭关系与心理健康：来自中国的证据
records.abstract_en: Mental health conditions are becoming a significant public health concern in the developing world. This paper examines the impact of housing wealth on an individual's mental health through the lens of family relationships. By leveraging the differential effects of China's National Six Policy, which modified down payment ratios and property deed taxes based on house size, we apply a Regression Discontinuity (RD) design to isolate the causal impact of housing wealth shocks on mental health outcomes. The analysis reveals that individuals experiencing positive housing wealth shocks exhibit lower rates of depression, increased life satisfaction, and greater confidence in the future. Additionally, we find that the effects of housing wealth shocks are particularly pronounced for individuals of lower socioeconomic status. The paper further explores the mechanisms through which housing wealth influences mental health, including improved marital satisfaction, stronger parent-child relationships, increased financial investments in children's education, changes in consumption patterns, alterations in employment status, more leisure time, and reduced health risk behaviors. Our findings underscore the substantial impact of housing wealth on enhancing household well-being, particularly in developing countries.
records.abstract_cn: 心理健康状况正在成为发展中国家的一个重大公共卫生问题。本文从家庭关系的角度探讨了住房财富对个人心理健康的影响。通过利用中国国六政策（根据房屋面积修改首付比例和房产契税）的差异效应，我们应用断点回归（RD）设计来识别住房财富冲击对心理健康结果的因果影响。分析显示，经历积极的住房财富冲击的个人抑郁率较低，生活满意度更高，对未来更有信心。此外，我们发现住房财富冲击的影响对于社会经济地位较低的个人尤其明显。论文进一步探讨了住房财富影响心理健康的机制，包括婚姻满意度的提高、亲子关系的加强、儿童教育财政投入的增加、消费模式的改变、就业状况的改变、休闲时间的增加以及健康风险行为的减少。我们的研究结果强调了住房财富对提高家庭福祉的重大影响，特别是在发展中国家。

records.title_en: Large-scale land acquisitions in Ethiopia: Impacts on agricultural productivity and deforestation
records.title_cn: 埃塞俄比亚的大规模土地收购：对农业生产率与森林砍伐的影响
records.abstract_en: Large-scale land acquisitions (LSLAs) have expanded rapidly in developing countries and promoted as a pathway to accelerate agricultural transformation. Yet, credible evidence on their developmental and environmental impacts remains limited. This paper provides causal evidence on the effects of LSLAs on agricultural production and forest outcomes by exploiting spatial and temporal variation in the staggered implementation of LSLAs in Gambella, Ethiopia. We combine geo-referenced administrative records on land transactions (2000–2020) with high-resolution remote sensing data on crop production, forest cover, and land use. Using a heterogeneity robust difference-in-difference estimator, we find no evidence that LSLAs increase agricultural production or the share of crop land. In contrast, it leads to significant and persistent declines in tree cover and forest land share. This deforestation-production paradox suggests that, in settings characterized by weak oversight and insufficient infrastructure, poorly regulated large-scale investments can generate substantial environmental burden without delivering the anticipated structural transformation that justifies them.
records.abstract_cn: 大规模土地收购（LSLA）在发展中国家迅速扩张，并被作为加速农业转型的途径而推广。然而，关于其发展和环境影响的可靠证据仍然有限。本文通过利用埃塞俄比亚甘贝拉交错实施 LSLA 的空间和时间变化，提供了 LSLA 对农业生产和森林成果影响的因果证据。我们将土地交易的地理参考行政记录（2000-2020）与作物生产、森林覆盖和土地利用的高分辨率遥感数据结合起来。使用异质性稳健的双重差分估计器，我们没有发现任何证据表明 LSLA 会增加农业产量或耕地份额。相反，它导致树木覆盖率和林地份额显著且持续的下降。这种毁林-生产悖论表明，在监管薄弱和基础设施不足的环境中，监管不善的大规模投资可能会产生巨大的环境负担，而无法实现预期的结构转型。

records.title_en: The benefits of public transit to households: Evidence from India
records.title_cn: 公共交通给家庭带来的收益：来自印度的证据
records.abstract_en: We measure benefits to households from Mumbai’s new Metro rail system. We estimate a commute mode choice model to value commute time savings in the short run and a housing choice model to value the improved commuting utility that households experience due to spatial sorting. Aggregate benefits from the Metro rail are over 10 times higher when spatial sorting occurs. In the short run women, college-educated workers, and workers with above median incomes experience higher benefits than their opposites. In the long run, households with lower incomes and assets and less than college education benefit more than their wealthier counterparts.
records.abstract_cn: 我们衡量孟买新地铁系统给家庭带来的收益。我们估计了一个通勤模式选择模型，以评估短期内节省的通勤时间，并估计了一个住房选择模型，以评估家庭因空间分选而体验到的通勤效用的改善。当空间分选发生时，地铁的总体效益会高出 10 倍以上。从短期来看，女性、受过大学教育的工人和收入高于中位数的工人比其他人享受到更高的福利。从长远来看，收入和资产较低以及大学教育程度较低的家庭比富裕家庭受益更多。

records.title_en: Who bears the cost: Financial frictions and labor markdown
records.title_cn: 谁承担成本：金融摩擦与劳动力买方压价
records.abstract_en: We present evidence of a connection between bank concentration and labor markdown in China. Using a large dataset on bank branch distribution and firm performance in China, we document that financial friction in the local market leads to significantly higher firm-level labor markdowns but has little impact on firms’ product markup and profitability. This suggests that firms pass the impact of financial friction to the labor market by exploiting labor when faced with higher financial costs. Such transmission of financial friction is more salient among low-skill-intensity or non-state-owned firms, and greater labor mobility facilitates the transmission. Our findings highlight the distributional effect of financial friction in the economy: labor, especially the low-skilled ones, rather than capital, eventually bears the cost of financial friction.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供了中国银行集中度与劳动力买方压价之间存在联系的证据。使用有关中国银行分支机构分布和企业绩效的大型数据集，我们发现当地市场的金融摩擦导致企业层面的劳动力买方压价显著更高，但对企业的产品加成和盈利能力几乎没有影响。这表明，当面临更高的融资成本时，企业会通过剥削劳动力将金融摩擦的影响传递给劳动力市场。这种金融摩擦的传导在低技能强度或非国有企业中更为突出，而更大的劳动力流动性则促进了这种传导。我们的研究结果强调了经济中金融摩擦的分配效应：最终承担金融摩擦成本的是劳动力，尤其是低技能劳动力，而不是资本。

records.title_en: Is high-speed internet detrimental for early childhood development? Evidence from a countrywide program
records.title_cn: 高速互联网对儿童早期发育有害吗？来自全国计划的证据
records.abstract_en: We estimate the effects of high-speed internet in early childhood development exploiting cross-cohort and geographic differences in the introduction of fiber-optic-to-the-home. Using variation in lifetime cumulative exposure to fiber optic and combining survey and administrative data, we estimate effects on cognitive and non-cognitive outcomes measured by validated screening tests. We show that an increase in 10 percentage points in lifetime exposure to fiber optic decreases development scores between 6% and 17% of a standard deviation in communication, problem solving and social skills. An analysis of heterogeneous effects shows that the negative impact is larger for children with more educated parents.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用引入光纤到户的跨群体和地理差异来估计高速互联网对儿童早期发展的影响。利用终生累积接触光纤的变化并结合调查和管理数据，我们估计了通过经过验证的筛选测试测量的对认知和非认知结果的影响。我们表明，终生光纤覆盖暴露每增加10个百分点，沟通、问题解决和社交技能的发展得分会下降标准差的6%至17%。异质效应分析表明，父母受教育程度较高的孩子受到的负面影响更大。

records.title_en: Forecasting long-run causal effects
records.title_cn: 预测长期因果效应
records.abstract_en: Randomized controlled trials (RCTs) are the gold standard in causal inference. However, it is difficult for decision-makers to rely on RCTs when evaluating interventions that affect long-run outcomes. We elicit 25,980 forecasts from 505 participants to test the ability of people to predict the long-run outcomes of RCTs whose results were unknown to participants. Experienced forecasters, academic experts, and laypeople predict the outcomes of seven RCTs, each of which measured long-run outcomes at time horizons of at least five years. Experienced forecasters and academics were more accurate than laypeople, and experienced forecasters outperformed academics, at least in part due to their superior calibration. Aggregated forecasts outperform individual forecasts, showing a clear wisdom-of-the-crowd effect, but neither experienced forecasters nor academics consistently outperform simple benchmarks. We see no evidence of improved forecasting accuracy from randomly providing participants with additional information about good forecasting practices, details about the RCT interventions, or specifics about the local study context.
records.abstract_cn: 随机对照试验（RCT）是因果推理的黄金标准。然而，决策者在评估影响长期结果的干预措施时很难依赖随机对照试验。我们从25,980参与者那里获得了505预测，以测试人们预测参与者未知的随机对照试验长期结果的能力。经验丰富的预测者、学术专家和外行人士预测了七个随机对照试验的结果，每个试验都测量了至少五年的长期结果。经验丰富的预测者和学者比外行更准确，而经验丰富的预测者的表现优于学者，至少部分原因在于他们具有出色的校准能力。总体预测优于个人预测，显示出明显的群体智慧效应，但经验丰富的预测者和学者都没有始终优于简单的基准。我们没有看到通过随机向参与者提供有关良好预测实践的附加信息、有关 RCT 干预措施的详细信息或有关当地研究背景的具体信息来提高预测准确性的证据。

records.title_en: Labor market competition and inequality
records.title_cn: 劳动力市场竞争和不平等
records.abstract_en: We exploit a novel opportunity to study the dynamics of wage inequality and labor market competition over the course of economic development. Our context is Lithuania, where two decades of sustained growth and labor market tightening coincided with a substantial decline in wage inequality. We first fit a two-way fixed-effects model with worker and firm heterogeneity and document that the compression of the variance of firm fixed effects has been the main source of the fall in inequality. Guided by a standard dynamic monopsony model, we then estimate firms’ labor supply elasticities and show that labor market competition has increased over the same period. Finally, we construct a shift-share instrument and provide evidence that new job opportunities created by the accession to the European Union in 2004 contributed to the fall in inequality through their impact on labor market competition in Lithuania.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用一个新的机会来研究经济发展过程中工资不平等和劳动力市场竞争的动态。我们的背景是立陶宛，该国二十年的持续增长和劳动力市场紧缩与工资不平等的大幅下降同时发生。我们首先拟合了具有工人和企业异质性的双向固定效应模型，并证明企业固定效应方差的压缩是不平等下降的主要根源。然后，在标准动态买方垄断模型的指导下，我们估计了企业的劳动力供给弹性，并表明劳动力市场竞争在同一时期有所加剧。最后，我们构建了一个份额转移工具变量，并提供证据表明，2004年加入欧盟所创造的新就业机会通过对立陶宛劳动力市场竞争的影响，有助于减少不平等。

records.title_en: The complementary role of information and contraceptive access in teen pregnancy
records.title_cn: 信息和避孕药具获取对青少年怀孕的补充作用
records.abstract_en: We investigate how information frictions affect the efficacy of contraception provision programs. We study a Costa-Rican initiative that combined two pillars: free access to long-acting-reversible contraceptives; and a tailored information campaign to raise awareness and correct for baseline misperceptions. Using administrative data and geographic variation in the initiative, we find a 16% decrease in the teen birth rate. We show information complements access: districts exposed to both pillars experience substantially larger reductions than those with contraception access alone. Using surveys on sexual behavior, we show the initiative shifted the information source from personal networks to healthcare professionals, amending misperceptions on sexual health.
records.abstract_cn: 我们调查信息摩擦如何影响避孕提供计划的有效性。我们研究了哥斯达黎加的一项倡议，该倡议结合了两个支柱：免费获得长效可逆避孕药具；以及量身定制的信息活动，以提高认识并纠正基线错误认知。利用该计划中的行政数据和地理差异，我们发现青少年出生率下降了16%。我们展示了信息与获取的补充：接触这两个支柱的地区比单独获取避孕措施的地区经历了更大的减少。通过对性行为的调查，我们表明该计划将信息源从个人网络转移到医疗保健专业人员，从而纠正了对性健康的误解。

records.title_en: Making information actionable: Experimental evidence from Kenyan courts
records.title_cn: 让信息转化为行动：来自肯尼亚法院的实验证据
records.abstract_en: We conduct a randomized controlled trial across Kenyan courts to tackle a major source of court delays: adjournments, i.e., postponements of cases to later dates without reaching a resolution. Partnering with the Kenyan Judiciary, we introduce a simple, cost-effective one-page document that outlines the main reasons for adjournments in each court. We test this intervention in two experimental arms: one where the information is shared with judges, and the other where it is shared with both judges and court user committees. Our intervention successfully prevents approximately 20,000 adjournments nationwide, with each adjournment previously delaying cases by an average of 3 months. The acceleration of court proceedings leads to a notable increase in the demand for and utilization of the legal system, increasing the filing of cases as well as citizen trust in the justice system. Our findings demonstrate that tackling the underlying reasons for court delays can substantially enhance both the perceived and actual performance of judicial systems, fostering greater usage and trust in legal institutions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在肯尼亚法院进行了一项随机对照试验，以解决法庭延误的一个主要根源：休庭，即在没有达成解决方案的情况下将案件推迟到稍后日期。我们与肯尼亚司法机构合作，推出了一份简单、经济高效的单页文件，概述了每个法院休庭的主要原因。我们在两个实验组中测试了这种干预措施：一个与法官共享信息，另一个与法官和法院用户委员会共享信息。我们的干预成功地阻止了全国范围内约 20,000 次延期，之前每次延期案件平均延迟 3 个月。法院诉讼的加速导致对法律系统的需求和利用显著增加，提高了立案率以及公民对司法系统的信任。我们的研究结果表明，解决法院拖延的根本原因可以大大提高司法系统的感知和实际表现，从而促进对法律机构的更多使用和信任。

records.title_en: Evaluating the environmental and economic implications of curbing transboundary pollution: Evidence from China
records.title_cn: 遏制跨界污染的环境与经济影响：来自中国的证据
records.abstract_en: Mitigating transboundary pollution requires internalizing environmental externalities and coordinating inter-jurisdictional interests. This paper examines the environmental and economic consequences of China's watershed ecological compensation (WEC) policy, a government-led property rights allocation scheme that combines Coasean bargaining with state-contingent contracts. By exploiting the progressive roll-out of inter-provincial WEC schemes and employing a difference-in-difference-in-differences design with a novel county-level dataset containing long-term industrial water pollutant information, we find that upstream counties experience significant reductions in pollution emissions but slower economic growth relative to their adjacent downstream counties after policy implementation. Event study estimates further indicate that environmental governance entailing high economic costs is difficult to sustain over time, reflecting a potential misalignment between costs and benefits in environmental protection. These effects can be attributed to pollution-control-oriented policy measures adopted by upstream local governments and the resulting responses of firms and residents. We further show that upstream local governments' prioritization of environmental governance is shaped by both economic and political incentives. Our findings offer insights into institutional design for improving transboundary water quality in countries with decentralized environmental management systems.
records.abstract_cn: 减轻跨境污染需要内部化环境外部性并协调不同辖区之间的利益。本文研究了中国流域生态补偿（WEC）政策的环境和经济后果，这是一种政府主导的产权分配计划，将科斯讨价还价与状态依存合约相结合。通过利用逐步推出的跨省WEC计划，并采用包含长期工业水污染物信息的新型县级数据集的三重差分设计，我们发现政策实施后，上游县的污染排放量显著减少，但相对于邻近下游县的经济增长却放缓。事件研究估计进一步表明，环境治理带来的高昂经济成本难以长期维持，反映出环境保护成本与效益之间潜在的错位。这些影响可以归因于上游地方政府采取的污染控制政策措施以及企业和居民的反应。我们进一步表明，上游地方政府对环境治理的优先顺序是由经济和政治动机共同决定的。我们的研究结果为具有分权式环境管理体系的国家改善跨境水质的制度设计提供了见解。

records.title_en: More power outages, more CO 2 emissions: Evidence from self-generation in China's manufacturing firms
records.title_cn: 更多停电，更多二氧化碳2排放：来自中国制造企业自发电的证据
records.abstract_en: Electricity unreliability is common in developing countries, yet its environmental impacts have rarely been systematically evaluated. We quantify the net impact of power outages on CO2 emissions in China from 2003 to 2010 using a novel framework that captures offsetting responses on both sides of the power system. We find that, in response to province-level grid outages, manufacturing firms fully compensate for the reduced electricity supply from more efficient centralized power plants connected to provincial grids by generating electricity with relatively inefficient captive power plants. This leads to a net increase in nationwide CO2 emissions. Quantitatively, firms’ self-generation responses to power outages in our sample lead to a nationwide net increase of approximately 4.898 million tons of CO2 per year. This self-generation response is concentrated among firms in non-locally supported industries, non-state-owned firms, and non-large taxpayers.
