This paper explains these facts by developing a search model with entry of investors and households, households choosing to own or rent in the presence of credit frictions, and homeowners deciding when to move house. A higher transaction tax reduces homeowners’ mobility and increases demand for rental properties, which explains the empirical facts and leads to a lower homeownership rate. The deadweight loss is large at 111% of tax revenue, with more than half of this due to distorting decisions to own or rent.
records.abstract_cn: 利用销售和租赁数据，本文发现三较高的房产交易税带来的新影响：尽管均征税，但买房出租交易增加，而买房自有交易减少，销售与租赁比率较低，房价与租金比率较低。本文通过开发一个搜索模型来解释这些事实，其中包括投资者和家庭、在存在信用摩擦的情况下选择拥有或租赁的家庭以及决定何时搬家的房主。较高的交易税会降低房主的流动性并增加对租赁房产的需求，这解释了经验事实并导致较低的住房拥有率。无谓损失占税收收入的111%很大，其中一半以上是由于扭曲的拥有或租赁决策造成的。

records.title_en: Slum Upgrading and Long-Run Urban Development: Evidence from Indonesia
records.title_cn: 贫民窟改造和长期城市发展：来自印度尼西亚的证据
records.abstract_en: Developing countries face massive urbanization and slum upgrading is a popular policy to improve shelter for many. Yet, preserving slums at the expense of formal developments can raise concerns of misallocation of land. We estimate causal, long-term impacts of the 1969–84 KIP programme, which provided basic upgrades to 5 million residents covering 25% of land in Jakarta, Indonesia. We assemble high-resolution data on programme boundaries and 2015 outcomes and address programme selection bias through localized comparisons. On average, KIP areas today have lower land values, shorter buildings, and are more informal, per a photographs-based slum index. The negative effects are concentrated within 5 km of the CBD. We develop a spatial equilibrium model to characterize the welfare implications of KIP. Counterfactuals suggest that 79% of the welfare effects stem from removing KIP in the centre and highlight how to mitigate losses to displaced residents.
records.abstract_cn: 发展中国家面临大规模城市化，贫民窟改造是改善许多人住房状况的一项流行政策。然而，以牺牲正式开发为代价来保护贫民窟可能会引起对土地分配不当的担忧。我们估计了 1969-84 KIP 计划的因果长期影响，该计划为覆盖印度尼西亚雅加达 5 土地的 25% 百万 居民提供了基本升级。我们收集有关项目边界和2015结果的高分辨率数据，并通过局部比较解决项目选择偏差。根据基于照片的贫民窟指数，平均而言，如今的 KIP 地区土地价值较低，建筑物较短，而且更加非正式。负面影响集中在CBD 5公里范围内。我们开发了一个空间均衡模型来描述 KIP 的福利影响。反事实表明，79% 的福利效应源于移除中心的 KIP，并强调如何减轻流离失所居民的损失。

records.title_en: Sanctions and the Exchange Rate
records.title_cn: 制裁和汇率
records.abstract_en: Trade wars and financial sanctions are again becoming an increasingly common part of the international economic landscape, and the dynamics of the exchange rate are often used in real time to evaluate the effectiveness of sanctions and policy responses. We show that sanctions limiting a country’s exports or freezing its assets depreciate the exchange rate, while sanctions limiting imports appreciate it, even when both types of policies have exactly the same effect on real allocations, including household welfare and government fiscal revenues. Beyond the direct effect from sanctions, increased precautionary savings in foreign currency also depreciate the exchange rate when they are not offset by the sale of official reserves or financial repression of foreign-currency savings. We show that the dynamics of the ruble exchange rate following Russia’s invasion of Ukraine in February 2022 are quantitatively consistent with the combined effects of these forces calibrated to the observed sanctions and government policies. We evaluate the associated welfare, fiscal and inflationary consequences for both Russia and the coalition of Western countries.
records.abstract_cn: 贸易战和金融制裁再次成为国际经济格局中越来越常见的一部分，汇率动态经常被用来实时评估制裁和政策反应的有效性。我们表明，限制一国出口或冻结其资产的制裁会使汇率贬值，而限制进口的制裁则会使汇率升值，即使这两种政策对实际分配（包括家庭福利和政府财政收入）具有完全相同的影响。除了制裁的直接影响之外，外币预防性储蓄的增加，如果不能通过出售官方储备或外币储蓄的金融抑制来抵消，也会导致汇率贬值。我们表明，二月2022俄罗斯入侵乌克兰后卢布汇率的动态在数量上与根据观察到的制裁和政府政策校准的这些力量的综合影响一致。我们评估了俄罗斯和西方国家联盟的相关福利、财政和通货膨胀后果。

records.title_en: Taxes Depress Corporate Borrowing: Evidence from Private Firms
records.title_cn: 税收抑制企业借贷：来自私营企业的证据
records.abstract_en: We use variation in state corporate income tax rates to re-examine the relation between taxes and corporate leverage. Contrary to prior research, corporate leverage rises after tax cuts for small private firms. An estimated dynamic equilibrium model shows that tax cuts make capital more productive and spur the use of leverage. Tax cuts also produce more distant default thresholds and lower credit spreads. These effects outweigh the lower interest tax deduction and lead to higher optimal leverage choices, especially for firms with flexible investment policies. The presence of the interest tax deduction raises consumer welfare in equilibrium.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用州企业所得税税率的变化来重新审视税收与企业杠杆之间的关系。与之前的研究相反，小型私营企业减税后企业杠杆率上升。估计的动态均衡模型表明，减税可以提高资本的生产率并刺激杠杆的使用。减税还带来了更遥远的违约门槛和更低的信用利差。这些影响超过了较低的利息税减免，并导致更高的最优杠杆选择，特别是对于投资政策灵活的公司而言。利息税减免的存在提高了消费者的均衡福利。

records.title_en: Supply Chain Disruption and Reorganization: Theory and Evidence From Ukraine’s War
records.title_cn: 供应链中断与重组：乌克兰战争的理论与证据
records.abstract_en: How do localized conflicts disrupt supply chains and prompt firms to reorganize them? How do these forces affect firm-level and aggregate economic activity? Using firm-to-firm Ukrainian railway-shipment data before and during the 2014 Russia–Ukraine conflict, we document that firms with prior supplier and buyer exposure to the conflict areas substantially decreased their output. Simultaneously, firms reorganized their production linkages away from partners directly or indirectly exposed to the conflict shock. We build a general-equilibrium production-network model with endogeneous link formation, and we show that our model’s sufficient statistics accurately explains the observed relative decline in firm output once we account for network reorganization. Calibrating our model to the Ukrainian economy, we find that the localized conflict decreased aggregate output in nonconflict areas by 5.5%. This effect increases to 8.4% if we abstract from endogeneous link formation, suggesting that production-network reorganization partially mitigates the detrimental, far-reaching aggregate economic costs of conflicts.
records.abstract_cn: 局部冲突如何扰乱供应链并促使企业重组供应链？这些力量如何影响企业层面和总体经济活动？使用2014俄罗斯-乌克兰冲突之前和期间的企业间乌克兰铁路运输数据，我们记录了先前供应商和买家接触过冲突地区的企业大幅减少了产量。与此同时，企业重组了生产联系，远离直接或间接遭受冲突冲击的合作伙伴。我们建立了一个具有内生链接形成的一般均衡生产网络模型，并且我们表明，一旦我们考虑了网络重组，我们的模型的充分统计数据就可以准确地解释所观察到的企业产出的相对下降。根据乌克兰经济校准我们的模型，我们发现局部冲突使非冲突地区的总产出下降了 5.5%。如果我们从内生联系的形成中抽象出来，这种效应会增加到8.4%，这表明生产网络重组部分减轻了冲突造成的有害的、影响深远的总经济成本。

records.title_en: All Along the Watchtower: Military Landholders and Serfdom Consolidation in Early Modern Russia
records.title_cn: 一直在瞭望塔：近代早期俄罗斯的军事土地所有者和农奴制巩固
records.abstract_en: This article examines the emergence of coercive labour institutions using the case of serfdom in early modern Russia. We argue that serfdom consolidated under the pressure of landholding military elites who gained political influence due to the prolonged struggle with steppe nomads. To contain nomadic raids, the Russian state erected defence lines on the southern frontier, and granted land in the area to soldiers in charge of its defence. The soldiers could not farm while on defence duty, nor could they compete in the market for peasant labour, as the land had been selected for its defensive rather than agricultural value. The system was therefore only sustainable by restricting labour mobility. In response to the volume of landholders’ collective petitions, the Russian state gradually tied peasants to the land and institutionalized serfdom in the written law. Using newly digitized population data from the 17th century, we show a higher prevalence of serfs and military landholders in districts on the defence line. We also find a higher prevalence of small estates—up to 25 serf households—sufficient to support a soldier and his family. Placebo tests show that these patterns do not hold for non-serf peasants, or for merchants and artisans. To ensure causality, we develop a novel algorithm that reconstructs the optimal invasion routes for nomads and pinpoints the optimal location of the defence line using topographic data. Our results highlight the primacy of political economy factors over purely economic ones, such as the land–labour ratio or the grain trade, in the development of serfdom. This sheds new light on the possible mechanisms of institutional divergence between Eastern and Western Europe in the early modern period.
records.abstract_cn: 本文以近代早期俄罗斯农奴制为例，考察了强制劳动制度的出现。我们认为，农奴制是在拥有土地的军事精英的压力下得到巩固的，这些精英由于与草原游牧民族的长期斗争而获得了政治影响力。为了遏制游牧民族的袭击，俄罗斯政府在南部边境设立了防线，并将该地区的土地授予负责防御的士兵。士兵们在执行国防任务时不能耕种，也不能在农民劳动力市场上竞争，因为选择土地是为了防御而非农业价值。因此，该体系只有通过限制劳动力流动才能维持。为了应对大量土地所有者的集体请愿，俄罗斯国家逐渐将农民与土地捆绑在一起，并通过成文法将农奴制制度化。使用17世纪新的数字化人口数据，我们发现防线地区农奴和军事土地所有者的比例较高。我们还发现小庄园的普遍存在——最多25个农奴家庭——足以养活一名士兵及其家人。安慰剂测试表明，这些模式不适用于非农奴农民、商人和工匠。为了确保因果关系，我们开发了一种新颖的算法，可以重建游牧民族的最佳入侵路线，并使用地形数据确定防线的最佳位置。我们的研究结果强调了在农奴制发展过程中，政治经济因素相对于土地-劳动力比率或粮食贸易等纯粹经济因素的重要性。这为近代早期东欧和西欧之间制度分歧的可能机制提供了新的线索。

records.title_en: Patents, News, and Business Cycles
records.title_cn: 专利、新闻和商业周期
records.abstract_en: We exploit information in patent applications to construct an instrumental variable for the identification of technology news shocks that relaxes all the identifying assumptions traditionally used in the literature. The instrument recovers news shocks that have no effect on aggregate productivity in the short-run, but are a significant driver of its trend component. The shock prompts a broad-based expansion in anticipation of the future increase in total factor productivity (TFP), with output, consumption, and investment all rising well before any material increase in TFP is recorded. Despite the positive conditional comovements, the shock only accounts for a modest share of fluctuations of macroeconomic aggregates at business cycle frequencies. Financial markets price-in news shocks on impact, while most of the macro aggregates respond with some delay.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用专利申请中的信息构建一个工具变量来识别技术新闻冲击，从而放松了文献中传统上使用的所有识别假设。该工具恢复了新闻冲击，这些冲击在短期内对总体生产率没有影响，但却是其趋势成分的重要驱动力。这种冲击促使人们对未来全要素生产率（TFP）增长的预期出现广泛的扩张，在 TFP 出现任何实质性增长之前，产出、消费和投资都在增长。尽管存在积极的条件联动，但冲击仅占商业周期频率宏观经济总量波动的一小部分。金融市场价格受到消息冲击，而大多数宏观总量的反应则有所延迟。

records.title_en: Introduction to the Special Issue
records.title_cn: 专题刊物导论
records.abstract_en: There is a long tradition in environmental economics of using visits to outdoor recreation sites to value environmental goods. Recreation demand (or travel cost) models combine data on trips individuals make to recreation destinations with imputed travel costs and attributes of recreation sites to

records.title_en: Quantifying Recreational Benefits from Fish Consumption Advisories
records.title_cn: 从渔业消费建议中量化休闲益处
records.abstract_en:
Abstract

This paper examines the impact of fish consumption advisories on recreational behavior and visitor welfare using large-scale mobility data from Michigan. By integrating cellphone-based location data with a discrete choice modeling framework, we estimate the causal effects of advisories on recreation site selection and quantify the associated welfare benefits of disclosing risks. Our findings show that advisories significantly deter recreational visits, with an average visitor willing to pay approximately $72 per visit to avoid sites under advisories. We also find that disclosure on advisories led to aggregated welfare benefits of $3.45 million annually, highlighting its broader recreational benefits.
records.abstract_cn:
摘要

本文利用密歇根州的大规模出行数据，研究渔业消费建议对休闲行为和游客福利的影响。通过将手机定位数据与离散选择模型相结合，估算建议对休闲地点选择的因果效应，并量化披露风险的相关福利收益。研究结果显示，建议显著抑制休闲访问，平均每位游客愿意支付约$72美元以避免在建议区域内的地点。我们还发现，建议披露带来了每年$3.45至$百万美元的整体福利收益，凸显其更广泛的休闲益处。

records.title_en: Causal Recreation Demand Estimation with Cell Phone Mobility Data
records.title_cn: 基于手机出行数据的休闲需求因果估计
records.abstract_en:
Abstract

Accurately estimating the welfare impacts of environmental changes in recreation demand modeling requires robust causal inference methods. However, a persistent challenge remains as the zero market share issue restricts the causal inference application to broader regions and longer periods. To address this, we integrate empirical Bayes posterior mean estimation into a two-step random coefficient logit model, ensuring that sites with low or zero visitation are properly incorporated without distorting demand estimates. We apply this framework to the 2021 Huntington Beach oil spill, using high-frequency cellphone data to track changes in beach visits. By combining the Synthetic Difference-in-Differences (SDID) approach with empirical Bayes-adjusted market shares, we examine the causal effects of temporary beach closures on visitor welfare. Our findings reveal that Huntington Beach experienced the largest and most prolonged welfare loss, with an estimated aggregate loss of $1.0 million and weekly losses of $83 thousand persisting beyond the initial closure. In contrast, Newport Beach and Laguna Beach exhibited faster recoveries. This study advances recreation demand modeling by refining demand estimation for low-visit sites and strengthening causal inference techniques for environmental disruptions, ultimately providing a more reliable framework for assessing the economic costs of beach closures and other environmental policy interventions.
records.abstract_cn:
摘要

在休闲需求模型中准确估算环境变化的福利影响需要稳健的因果推断方法。然而，零市场份额问题限制了因果推断的应用范围至更广泛的区域和更长的时期。为此，本文将经验贝叶斯后验均值估计融入二步骤的随机系数逻辑模型，确保低访次或零访问量较少的地点得以合理纳入，而不扭曲需求估计。我们将该框架应用于2021亨廷顿海滩石油泄漏事件，利用高频手机数据追踪海滩访问变化。通过结合合成差分法（SDID）与经验贝叶斯调整的市场份额，我们分析了临时海滩关闭对游客福利的因果影响。研究结果显示，亨廷顿海滩经历了最大且持续时间最长的福利损失，估算总损失为1.0 百万美元，且每周损失为83 千美元，且这种损失持续超出初次关闭期。相比之下，纽波特海滩和拉古纳海滩的恢复速度较快。本研究通过改进低访次地点的需求估算和增强环境扰动的因果推断技术，推动了休闲需求模型的发展，最终为评估海滩关闭及其他环境政策干预的经济成本提供了更为可靠的分析框架。

records.title_en: Valuing Offshore Habitat to Recreational Anglers Using Cell Phone Location Data
records.title_cn: 利用手机位置数据评估近海栖息地对休闲钓鱼者的价值
records.abstract_en:
Abstract

Offshore structures, including operational and reefed energy platforms, strengthen marine habitats and generate economic value, motivating interest in quantifying their net benefits. We combine a Random Utility Model with Murdock9s (2006) site-choice approach to estimate the nonmarket value of offshore structures to recreational anglers in the Western Gulf of Mexicoi (2019-2022). Recreational fishing trips are identified in cellphone location data using a machine learning classifier trained on Automatic Identification System data. Location choices indicate that anglers value destinations farther offshore, particularly those with operating and reefed energy platforms, while other artificial reefs generate smaller and spatially variable benefits.
records.abstract_cn:
摘要

近海结构，包括运营中的和改造成礁石的能源平台，能够增强海洋栖息地并产生经济价值，这激发了人们对量化其净收益的兴趣。我们将随机效用模型与Murdock（2006）的场所选择方法相结合，估计了2019-2022年墨西哥湾西部休闲钓鱼者对近海结构的非市场价值。通过使用基于自动识别系统数据训练的机器学习分类器，在手机位置数据中识别出休闲钓鱼旅行。位置选择表明，钓鱼者更看重更远的近海目的地，特别是那些有运营和改造成礁石的能源平台的目的地，而其他人工礁石则产生较小且空间可变的收益。

records.title_en: Estimating the Economic Value of Grassland Tourism Services Based on Mobile Phone Data
records.title_cn: 基于手机信令数据的草原旅游服务经济价值估算
records.abstract_en:
Abstract

This study evaluates the economic value of grassland tourism in Inner Mongolia, China, using mobile phone signaling data to track tourist flows from 333 cities to 103 counties in 2020. A zonal travel cost model, both parametric and non-parametric, was employed. Results indicate the tourism value ranged from 585.9 to 598.4 billion CNY (US $84.9–86.7 billion), about 2.5 times the tourism revenue, constituting 29% of regional GDP. In the absence of COVID-19, the value would have reached 936.5 billion CNY. The study reveals spatial disparities, with grassland quality, infrastructure, and regional development driving tourism value.
records.abstract_cn:
摘要

本研究利用手机信令数据追踪333年103个城市到2020个县的旅游流量，评估了中国内蒙古草原旅游的经济价值。采用参数化和非参数化的分区旅行成本模型。结果表明，旅游价值在585.9至598.4亿元人民币（84.9至86.7亿美元）之间，约为旅游收入的2.5倍，占区域GDP的29%。在没有COVID-19的情况下，该价值将达到936.5亿元人民币。研究揭示了空间差异，草原质量、基础设施和区域发展是驱动旅游价值的因素。

records.title_en: Are Mobile Device Location Data a Substitute for Travel Cost Surveys?
records.title_cn: 移动设备位置数据能否替代旅游成本调查？
records.abstract_en:
Abstract

Mobile device location data offer a low-cost alternative for measuring visitation to outdoor recreation sites and are known to correlate with official visitation counts. Less is known about whether these data can recover recreation demand and consumer surplus comparable to surveybased methods. We compare travel cost models estimated using mobile device and survey data for 17 U.S. National Park Service sites. Results are mixed. We examine the roles of aggregation and sampling bias and use LASSO regression to assess whether sample and site characteristics explain discrepancies.
records.abstract_cn:
摘要

移动设备位置数据为衡量户外休闲场所访客量提供了一种低成本的替代方法，并且已知与官方访客统计数据存在相关性。关于这些数据是否能够恢复与调查方法相当的休闲需求和消费者剩余，尚不清楚。我们比较了使用移动设备数据和调查数据估算的美国国家公园管理局（17）场所的旅游成本模型。结果存在差异。我们考察了聚合和抽样偏差的作用，并采用LASSO回归评估样本和场所特征是否能解释差异。

records.title_en: Impact of Water Quality at the Beach on Disadvantaged Communities in Rhode Island
records.title_cn: 海滩水质对罗德岛弱势群体的影响
records.abstract_en:
Abstract

Urbanization and agriculture have degraded US coastal waters, causing beach closures and disparities in access to clean beaches. This study examines racial and income disparities in how water quality affects recreational beach use in the southern Northeastern United States, using cell phone mobility data and satellite-derived water clarity measures. Results from a multiple-site zonal travel cost model show that improved water clarity increases beach visitation, with larger benefits accruing to more affluent, less diverse communities. These findings suggest that the recreational benefits of water quality improvements are inequitably distributed and have implications for policies prioritizing disadvantaged coastal communities.
records.abstract_cn:
摘要

城市化和农业活动已导致美国沿海水域退化，造成海滩关闭和清洁海滩访问的不平等。本研究采用手机出行数据和卫星水体透明度测量，分析了美国东北部南部地区水质对休闲海滩使用的种族和收入差异。多站点区域旅行成本模型的结果显示，改善水体透明度能增加海滩访问次数，且更富裕、少数族裔比例较低的社区受益更大。这些发现表明，水质改善带来的休闲益处分配不平等，并对优先考虑弱势沿海社区的政策具有启示意义。

records.title_en: Evaluating Mobility Data for Recreation Monitoring
records.title_cn: 评估出行数据在休闲监测中的应用
records.abstract_en:
Abstract

Mobile device location data (or mobility data, MD) are a novel and exciting source of information for recreational monitoring. In this paper we analyze datasets from four commercial vendors across three case studies to illustrate some important challenges. Our results show inconsistent spatial-temporal patterns and correlations with on-site counts. Given this evidence, we describe a conceptual model of the potential sources of error and structural variability in visitation estimates derived from MD. We discuss approaches for evaluation of data quality and suggest a range of supplemental data products that vendors could provide to support recreation analysis.
records.abstract_cn:
摘要

移动设备位置数据（或出行数据，MD）是一种新颖且令人振奋的休闲监测信息来源。本文分析了来自四商业供应商在三案例研究中的数据集，以说明一些重要的挑战。我们的结果显示空间-时间模式和与现场计数的相关性不一致。鉴于这些证据，我们描述了一个关于由MD得出的访客估算中的潜在误差源和结构性变异的概念模型。我们讨论了数据质量评估的方法，并建议供应商可以提供一系列补充数据产品，以支持休闲分析。

records.title_en: Smart Device Recreation Data
records.title_cn: 智能设备休闲数据
records.abstract_en:
Abstract

Human mobility data (MD) from smartphones may offer a scalable alternative to fieldwork for Natural Resource Damage Assessments (NRDAs) and non-market valuation. We test MD9s utility for estimating recreational demand changes after a 2019 Houston tank fire. We apply count regressions and zonal travel cost models to calculate welfare losses. While this MD dataset reflects expected temporal patterns, comparisons with reference data reveal that "coverage rates" vary significantly across sites. This measurement error complicates counterfactual predictions. Economists should use caution when deriving absolute recreational value from MD.
records.abstract_cn:
摘要

来自智能手机的人类流动数据（MD）可能为自然资源损害评估（NRDAs）和非市场估值提供一种可扩展的替代实地调查的方法。我们检验了MD在估算2019休斯顿油罐火灾后休闲需求变化中的实用性。我们采用计数回归和区域旅行成本模型来计算福利损失。虽然该MD数据集反映了预期的时间模式，但与参考数据的比较显示，“覆盖率”在不同地点存在显著差异。这一测量误差增加了反事实预测的复杂性。经济学家在从MD中推导绝对休闲价值时应保持谨慎。

records.title_en: Evaluating Precision, Privacy, and Representation with Cell Phone Data
records.title_cn: 利用手机数据评估精准性、隐私保护与代表性
records.abstract_en:
Abstract

While mobility data has emerged as a promising alternative for assessing the economic value of recreation, their reliability depends critically on how data are processed and protected. This paper systematically evaluates how key data-handling practices affect the accuracy of recreation demand estimation. Using a random utility model to analyze recreation visits at Cape Cod beaches from 2019-2022, we evaluate how methodological choices influence the marginal willingness to pay (MWTP) for avoiding fecal bacteria contamination. We find an average MWTP of $8.92 per visit when using the proposed practices, such as refined visit definitions, sampling weights, and long-term choice sets. Deviations from these practices can introduce significant biases: relaxing the minimum dwell time and applying differential privacy reduce MWTP by 57% and 65%, respectively, while short-term choice set definition inflates it by 10%. By demonstrating the sensitivity of welfare estimates to data-processing decisions, this study highlights the importance of transparent and judicious mobility data practices for credible environmental valuation and evidence-based policymaking.
records.abstract_cn:
摘要

虽然流动性数据已成为评估休闲经济价值的有前景的替代方案，但其可靠性在很大程度上依赖于数据的处理和保护方式。本文系统评估了关键数据处理方法如何影响休闲需求估算的准确性。利用随机效用模型分析来自2019-2022的凯普科德海滩休闲访问数据，我们评估了方法选择对避免粪便细菌污染的边际支付意愿（MWTP）的影响。结果显示，采用所提出的实践方法（如细化访问定义、采样权重和长期选择集）时，平均MWTP为8.92美元每次访问。偏离这些做法可能引入显著偏差：放宽最短停留时间和应用差分隐私分别使MWTP降低57%和65%，而短期选择集定义则使其上升10%。通过展示福利估算对数据处理决策的敏感性，本研究强调了透明且审慎的流动性数据处理实践在可信环境价值评估和循证政策制定中的重要性。

records.title_en: Training, Communications Patterns, and Spillovers inside Organizations
records.title_cn: 培训、沟通模式与组织内部溢出效应
records.abstract_en: This paper examines how training affects productivity across hierarchical layers within organizations. After a randomized training program for frontline employees at a government agency, trained workers’ output increased while their requests for managerial assistance fell. This freed managers to focus on strategic tasks—particularly managers with the strongest connections to trained employees. A structural model of organizational hierarchy shows that spillovers to managers account for approximately 45% of the program’s total benefits, indicating that evaluations focused solely on individual trainees may substantially understate the full value of training investments.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了培训如何影响组织内不同层级的生产率。在对某政府机构一线员工进行随机培训项目后，受训员工的产出提升，同时他们对管理层的协助请求减少。这使得管理者能够将更多精力集中于战略性任务，尤其是与受训员工联系最紧密的管理者。组织层级的结构模型显示，管理者的溢出效应约占项目总收益的45%，表明仅关注个体受训者的评估可能会大幅低估培训投资的整体价值。

records.title_en: A Method to Estimate Discrete Choice Models That Is Robust to Consumer Search
records.title_cn: 一种对消费者搜索具有稳健性的离散选择模型估计方法
records.abstract_en: We state conditions under which choice data suffice to identify preferences when consumers may not be fully informed about attributes of goods. Our approach can be used to test for full information, forecast how consumers will respond to information, and conduct welfare analysis when consumers are imperfectly informed. In a lab experiment, we successfully forecast the average response to new information when consumers engage in costly search. In data from Expedia, our method identifies which attribute was not immediately visible to consumers in search results and allows us to compute the value of additional information.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了在消费者可能对商品属性并非完全知情的情况下，仅凭选择数据即可识别偏好的条件。我们的方法可用于检验完全信息、预测消费者对信息的反应，并在消费者信息不完全时进行福利分析。在一项实验室实验中，当消费者进行有成本的搜索时，我们成功预测了其对新信息的平均反应。在Expedia的数据中，我们的方法识别出搜索结果中消费者未能立即看到的属性，并使我们能够计算额外信息的价值。

records.title_en: The Macroeconomic Consequences of Early Childhood Development Policies
records.title_cn: 早期儿童发展政策的宏观经济后果
records.abstract_en: To study long-run large-scale early childhood policies, this paper incorporates early childhood investments into a general equilibrium heterogeneous agent overlapping generations model calibrated using US data. A randomized controlled trial evaluation of a short-run small-scale early childhood program in the model predicts effects on children’s education and income that are similar to the empirical evidence. A long-run large-scale program, however, yields over twice as large welfare gains as those of a short-run small-scale program even after considering general equilibrium and taxation effects. Key to this difference is that investing in a child not only improves her skills but also creates better ancestors for future generations.
records.abstract_cn: 为研究长期、大规模的早期儿童政策，本文将早期儿童投资纳入一个基于美国数据校准的异质性代理人重叠世代一般均衡模型。模型中对短期、小规模早期儿童项目的随机对照试验评估预测了对儿童教育和收入的影响，与实证证据相似。然而，长期、大规模项目即使考虑一般均衡和税收效应，其福利增益也超过短期、小规模项目的两倍。造成这一差异的关键在于，对儿童的投资不仅提升其技能，还为未来世代创造更优的祖先。

records.title_en: The Zero-Beta Interest Rate
records.title_cn: 零贝塔利率
records.abstract_en: We use equity returns to construct a time-varying measure of the zero-beta interest rate: the expected return of a stock portfolio orthogonal to the stochastic discount factor. In contrast to safe rates, the zero-beta rate fits the aggregate consumption Euler equation remarkably well both unconditionally and conditional on monetary policy shocks and is high, volatile, and persistent enough to explain the average return and most of the volatility of the market portfolio. The puzzle is why safe rates are so low, stable, and disconnected from both consumption and the zero-beta rate.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用股票收益率构建了一个随时间变化的零贝塔利率度量：即与随机贴现因子正交的股票投资组合的预期收益率。与无风险利率相比，零贝塔利率无论在无条件还是在货币政策冲击条件下，都能非常好地拟合总体消费的欧拉方程，并且其水平较高、波动性大且具有持续性，足以解释市场投资组合的平均收益和大部分波动性。令人困惑的是，无风险利率为何如此低、稳定，并且与消费和零贝塔利率都脱节。

records.title_en: Financial Aid and Upward Mobility: Evidence from Colombia’s Ser Pilo Paga
records.title_cn: 助学金与向上流动：来自哥伦比亚“Ser Pilo Paga”项目的证据
records.abstract_en: We study the impact of financial aid on upward mobility. We estimate the causal impacts of a Colombian policy targeting high-achieving, low-socioeconomic-status students on later-life educational and labor market outcomes. Using regression discontinuity design, difference-in-differences, and population-wide administrative microdata, we find that the policy boosted attendance and completion at high-value-added colleges, particularly in STEM fields. Improved college quality led to greater skill development. Nine years later, recipients earn 18 log points more and are more likely to reach the top 1%. The policy narrowed socioeconomic gaps in college quality, attainment, skill development, earnings, and returns to ability, improving equity and efficiency.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究助学金对向上流动的影响。我们估计哥伦比亚一项针对高成就、低社会经济地位学生的政策对其后期教育和劳动力市场结果的因果影响。采用回归不连续设计、双重差分方法以及覆盖全体人口的行政微观数据，我们发现该政策提升了学生在高增值高校，尤其是STEM领域的入学率和毕业率。高校质量的提升带来了更高的技能发展。九年后，受益者的收入高出18个对数点，并且更有可能进入收入前1%。该政策缩小了社会经济地位在高校质量、学历、技能发展、收入和能力回报方面的差距，提升了公平性和效率。

records.title_en: The Gas Trap: Outcompeting Coal versus Renewables
records.title_cn: 天然气陷阱：与煤炭和可再生能源的竞争
records.abstract_en: We analyze a fundamental dilemma and time-inconsistency problem facing climate-concerned producers of natural gas. In the short term, it is tempting to produce more to outcompete coal. When this policy is anticipated, however, investments in renewables fall and emissions may ultimately increase. When the gas producers cannot precommit, their policies can be counterproductive. A simulated version applied to Europe verifies that the gas trap is quantitatively important. We discuss the robustness of this result and possible solutions, ranging from direct investments in renewables to taxes on the search and exploration of gas.
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了关注气候的天然气生产商所面临的一个基本困境和时间不一致性问题。短期内，增加产量以击败煤炭具有诱惑力。然而，当这一政策被预期时，可再生能源的投资会下降，排放最终可能增加。当天然气生产商无法事先承诺时，其政策可能适得其反。应用于欧洲的模拟结果验证了天然气陷阱在量化上具有重要意义。我们讨论了这一结果的稳健性及可能的解决方案，包括直接投资可再生能源和对天然气勘探征税等。

records.title_en: The Origin of the State: Land Productivity or Appropriability? A Comment
records.title_cn: 国家起源：土地生产率还是可攫取性？——评论
records.abstract_en: Mayshar, Moav, and Pascali apply an instrumental variables identification strategy to data from nearly 1,000 societies included in the Ethnographic Atlas to claim that cultivation of cereals (appropriable by elites), rather than increased land productivity following the adoption of agriculture, led to the development of the state. We show two things. (1) Evidence for the appropriability theory holds when moving from a tribe-chiefdom to a state and not more broadly. (2) Conclusions are driven by a handful of outliers with statistical significance at the 10% level lost with winsorization at 2.1% (or trimming at 1.2%) of locations by cereal advantage.
records.abstract_cn: Mayshar、Moav和Pascali利用工具变量识别策略，分析《民族志图谱》收录的近1,000个社会，认为与农业出现后土地生产率提高相比，精英能够攫取的谷物种植更能解释国家的形成。本文提出两点修正：（1）可攫取性理论的证据只适用于从部落酋邦向国家转变的情形，并不具有更普遍的解释力；（2）结论主要由少数离群值驱动。当按谷物优势对地点进行2.1%的缩尾处理（或1.2%的截尾处理）后，其在10%水平上的统计显著性消失。

records.title_en: Profits of Prejudiced Algorithms
records.title_cn: 偏见算法的利润
records.abstract_en: Firms are starting to replace humans with algorithms in important screening decisions, but there are potential spillovers of human biases contained in datasets to subsequent algorithmic predictions. When these biases are motivated by human prejudices, there are risks of algorithms perpetuating discrimination. I prove that when datasets are generated by a sufficiently discriminatory human, firms are more profitable when training discriminatory algorithms. If instead enough affirmative action is instituted in favor of a disadvantaged group, firms are more profitable when training algorithms that inflate scores for this group, but this effect diminishes with excess affirmative action.
records.abstract_cn: 公司开始在重要的筛选决策中用算法替代人类，但数据集中包含的人类偏见可能对后续的算法预测产生潜在的溢出效应。当这些偏见源于人类的偏见时，算法可能会延续歧视。我证明，当数据集是由一个足够歧视的人生成时，公司在训练歧视性算法时更有利可图。如果相反，针对弱势群体实施了足够的平权行动，公司在训练为该群体提高分数的算法时更有利可图，但这种效果在过度平权行动下会减弱。

records.title_en: When Is Discrimination Unfair?
records.title_cn: 何时歧视是不公平的？
records.abstract_en: We use a vignette-based survey experiment to elicit respondents’ assessments of the fairness of race-based hiring decisions and compare these assessments with the predictions of four preregistered ethical frameworks. While conservative respondents are much more accepting of discriminatory actions than others, respondents of all political leanings rate the relative fairness of different actions in a very similar way. A two-group framework in which one group (mostly self-described conservatives) values employers’ decision rights, the other has utilitarian concerns, and both groups use the same race-blind rules to assign relative fairness levels to actions explains our data well.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用基于情境的调查实验来引导受访者评估基于种族的招聘决策的公平性，并将这些评估与四预注册伦理框架的预测进行比较。虽然保守派受访者对歧视性行为的接受程度远高于其他人，但所有政治倾向的受访者对不同行为的相对公平性评估非常相似。一个二群体框架，其中一群体（主要是自我描述为保守派的人）重视雇主的决策权，另一个则关注功利主义，两组都使用相同的无种族规则来为行为分配相对公平性水平，能够很好地解释我们的数据。

records.title_en: Gene-Environment Complementarity in Educational Attainment
records.title_cn: 教育成就中的基因-环境互补性
records.abstract_en: Firstborns, on average, complete more education than laterborns. We study whether individuals’ endowments measured by genetic information amplify this effect. Our family fixed effects approach exploits exogenous variation in birth order and genetic endowments among 14,850 siblings in the UK Biobank. We find that those with higher genetic endowments benefit disproportionately more from being firstborn compared with those with lower endowments—a clean example of how nature and nurture interact in producing human capital. Since parental investments are a dominant channel driving birth order effects, our results are consistent with complementarity between endowments and investments in human capital formation.
records.abstract_cn: 长子平均完成的教育比晚出生的孩子更多。我们研究个体的遗传信息所测量的禀赋是否会放大这一效应。我们的家庭固定效应方法利用了英国生物库中14,850兄弟姐妹的出生顺序和遗传禀赋的外生变异。我们发现，遗传禀赋较高的人相比于遗传禀赋较低的人，从长子身份中受益的程度更大——这是自然与养育在生产人力资本中相互作用的一个清晰例子。由于父母投资是驱动出生顺序效应的主要渠道，我们的结果与禀赋与人力资本形成投资之间的互补性是一致的。

records.title_en: Does Monitoring Change Teacher Pedagogy and Student Outcomes?
records.title_cn: 监控是否改变教师教学法和学生成果？
records.abstract_en: In theory, monitoring can improve employee motivation and effort, particularly in settings lacking measurable outputs, but research assessing monitoring as a motivator is limited to laboratory settings. To address this gap, I leverage exogenous variation in the presence and intensity of teacher monitoring, in the form of unannounced in-class observations as part of DC public schools’ IMPACT program. As monitoring intensifies, teachers use more individualized teaching and emphasize higher-level learning. When teachers are unmonitored, their students have lower test scores and increased suspensions. This evidence validates monitoring as a potential tool for enhancing teacher pedagogy and employee performance more broadly.
records.abstract_cn: 理论上，监控可以提高员工的积极性和努力程度，特别是在缺乏可测量输出的环境中，但评估监控作为激励因素的研究仅限于实验室环境。为了解决这一空白，我利用教师监控的存在和强度的外生变化，以华盛顿特区公立学校IMPACT项目中的未通知课堂观察为形式。随着监控的加强，教师采用更多个性化的教学，并强调更高层次的学习。当教师未被监控时，他们的学生测试成绩较低，停学率增加。这一证据验证了监控作为提升教师教学法和更广泛的员工绩效的潜在工具。

records.title_en: Instrumental Variables with Unordered Treatments: Theory and Evidence from Returns to Fields of Study
records.title_cn: 无序处理的工具变量：来自学习领域回报的理论与证据
records.abstract_en: We revisit the 2016 identification argument of Kirkeboen and colleagues, who showed how one may combine instruments for multiple unordered treatments with information about individuals’ ranking of these treatments to achieve identification while allowing for heterogeneity in treatment effects. We show that the key identifying assumptions have testable implications and provide a new characterization of the bias that may arise if these assumptions are violated. We estimate and compare the earnings payoffs to postsecondary fields of study in Norway and Denmark. We empirically examine whether and why the payoffs to fields of study differ across the two countries.
records.abstract_cn: 我们重新审视Kirkeboen及其同事的2016识别论证，他们展示了一如何结合多个无序处理的工具与个体对这些处理的排名信息，以实现识别，同时允许处理效应的异质性。我们表明，关键的识别假设具有可检验的含义，并提供了对这些假设被违反时可能出现的偏差的新表征。我们估计并比较挪威和丹麦的高等教育学习领域的收入回报。我们实证检验了学习领域的回报在二国家之间是否以及为何存在差异。

records.title_en: Customer Discrimination in the Workplace: Evidence from Online Sales
records.title_cn: 职场中的客户歧视：来自在线销售的证据
records.abstract_en: Many workers are evaluated on their ability to engage with customers. We measure the impact of gender-based customer discrimination on the productivity of online sales agents in sub-Saharan Africa. Using a novel framework that randomly varies the gender of names presented to customers without changing worker behavior, we find that the assignment of a female-sounding name leads to 50% fewer purchases. Customers also lag in responding, are less expressive, and avoid discussing purchases. We show similar results for customers around the world and across workers. Removing customer bias, we find that women would be more productive than their male coworkers.
records.abstract_cn: 许多员工的评估基于他们与客户的互动能力。我们测量了基于性别的客户歧视对撒哈拉以南非洲在线销售人员生产力的影响。使用一种新颖的框架，随机改变呈现给客户的名字的性别而不改变员工行为，我们发现分配一个女性化名字会导致 50% 较少的购买。客户的响应也滞后，表达不够丰富，并且避免讨论购买。我们在全球范围内和不同员工中显示了类似的结果。消除客户偏见后，我们发现女性的生产力会高于她们的男性同事。

records.title_en: Working Hours, Top Management Appointments, and Gender: Evidence from Linked Employer-Employee Data
records.title_cn: 工作时间、高层管理任命与性别：来自链接雇主-员工数据的证据
records.abstract_en: Using Danish registry data linked to the Labor Force Survey, we provide the first rigorous evidence with external validity on the hours-career nexus (positive association between hours and career success). Guided by three theories (human capital, rat race, tournament), we unpack the hours-career nexus through examining the differential effect of hours in the present firm and elsewhere, hours relative to peers’ hours, standard versus evening/night/weekend hours, and the importance of sustaining long hours. Supplemented by the time use survey, we show that the gender gap in hours and career success is mostly due to gendered division of labor in household production.
records.abstract_cn: 利用与劳动市场调查链接的丹麦注册数据，我们提供了关于工作时间与职业成功之间关系（工作时间与职业成功之间的正相关）的严谨证据，具有外部有效性。根据人力资本、竞争和锦标赛理论，我们通过考察当前公司与其他公司的工作时间差异、相对于同龄人工作时间的比较、标准工作时间与晚间/夜间/周末工作时间的差异，以及维持长时间工作的重要性，来解构工作时间与职业成功之间的关系。通过时间使用调查的补充，我们表明，工作时间和职业成功之间的性别差距主要是由于家庭生产中的性别分工造成的。

records.title_en: Beyond IQ: The Rising Value of Extraversion
records.title_cn: 超越智商：外向性价值的上升
records.abstract_en: We analyze trends in labor market returns to psychological traits using data from half a million Finnish men from 2001 to 2015. Cognitive skills’ value declined, while noncognitive skills’ value increased. Our novel findings show that extraversion drives this rise, while conscientiousness remains stable. Extraversion’s rising returns are most pronounced for lower earners and those on the employment margin. These traits predict different labor market paths: extraversion predicts lower education and more work experience, while cognitive ability and conscientiousness lead to higher education and high-paying jobs.
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了使用来自2001到2015的半个百万芬兰男性的数据，心理特征在劳动市场的回报趋势。认知技能的价值下降，而非认知技能的价值上升。我们的新发现表明，外向性推动了这一上升，而尽责性保持稳定。外向性回报的上升在低收入者和处于就业边缘的人群中最为明显。这些特征预测了不同的劳动市场路径：外向性预测较低的教育水平和更多的工作经验，而认知能力和尽责性则导致更高的教育水平和高薪工作。

records.title_en: Consumption and Income Inequality across Generations
records.title_cn: 代际消费与收入不平等
records.abstract_en: This paper characterizes the joint evolution of income and consumption inequality across generations. We estimate a model featuring intergenerational persistence and family-independent idiosyncratic heterogeneity. We find that inequality in income and consumption is predominantly driven by idiosyncratic factors rather than intergenerational linkages. We show evidence of consumption insurance against idiosyncratic lifetime income risk, particularly for the bottom and top quartiles of income. Parental income is a significant source of this insurance only for the richest quartile.
records.abstract_cn: 本文描述了代际间收入与消费不平等的共同演变。我们估计了一个包含代际持续性和家庭独立的特异性异质性的模型。我们发现，收入和消费的不平等主要是由特异性因素驱动，而非代际联系。我们展示了针对特异性终身收入风险的消费保险的证据，特别是在收入的底部和顶部四分位数。父母收入仅对最富裕的四分位数是这一保险的重要来源。

records.title_en: The Economics of Gender-Specific Minimum Wage Legislation
records.title_cn: 性别特定最低工资立法的经济学分析
records.abstract_en: Using full count US census data, we study the impact of early twentieth-century state-industry-specific minimum wage laws that primarily targeted female employees. Our triple-difference estimates suggest a null impact of the minimum wage laws, potentially reflecting disemployment effects and the positive selection bias of the workers remaining in the labor force. When comparing county-industry trends between counties straddling state borders, female employment is lower by around 3.1% in affected county-industry cells. We further investigate the implications for own-wage elasticity of labor demand as a function of cross-industry concentration, the channels of substitution between men and women, and heterogeneity by marital status.
records.abstract_cn: 利用美国人口普查全样本数据，我们研究了二十世纪早期主要针对女性雇员的州-行业特定最低工资法律的影响。我们的三重差分估计结果显示最低工资法律的影响为零，可能反映了就业减少效应以及留在劳动力市场的工人存在正向选择偏差。在比较跨州边界县的县-行业趋势时，受影响的县-行业单元中女性就业率低约3.1%。我们进一步考察了劳动需求自身工资弹性作为跨行业集中度函数的含义、男女之间的替代渠道，以及按婚姻状况的异质性。

records.journal_name: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
records.title_en: Are We Doing More Harm than Good? Using Hypothetical Bias Reduction Techniques in Consequential Decision Settings
records.title_cn: 我们是在造成更多伤害还是带来更多益处？在有结果导向的决策环境中使用假设偏差降低技术
records.abstract_en: Researchers deploying stated preference surveys to value public goods commonly use techniques designed to reduce bias in hypothetical choice settings. This practice is at odds with evidence that most survey respondents perceive that their decisions are not hypothetical but instead have economic consequences. We examine three bias reduction procedures in both hypothetical and incentive-compatible, real payment settings: cheap talk, solemn oath, and certainty adjustment. We confirm that adjusting hypothetical choices based on response certainty or using a solemn oath can reduce hypothetical bias. In the incentive-compatible decision setting, the oath increases willingness to pay (WTP), and certainty adjustment can lead to serious distortions in demand estimates. Cheap talk does not alter mean WTP but leads to a stark difference in WTP across sexes. To minimize unintended consequences, our results suggest that survey researchers should deploy screening questions to better target these hypothetical bias reduction techniques.
records.abstract_cn: 研究人员在利用陈述偏好调查对公共产品进行价值评估时，通常采用旨在减少假设选择环境中偏差的技术。这一做法与证据相悖，后者表明大多数调查受访者认为其决策并非假设性，而是具有经济后果。我们在假设性和激励兼容的真实支付环境中检验了三偏差降低程序：廉价谈话、庄严誓言和确定性调整。我们确认，基于回应确定性调整假设性选择或使用庄严誓言可以减少假设偏差。在激励兼容的决策环境中，誓言提高了支付意愿（WTP），而确定性调整可能导致需求估计出现严重扭曲。廉价谈话不改变平均支付意愿，但在性别之间导致支付意愿的显著差异。为了最大限度减少意外后果，我们的结果建议调查研究者应采用筛查问题，以更好地针对这些假设偏差降低技术。

records.journal_name: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
records.title_en: Shock Avoidance: High Bill Alert Programs and Energy Consumption
records.title_cn: 避免冲击：高账单预警项目与能源消费
records.abstract_en: Utilities have invested billions of dollars in advanced metering infrastructure (AMI) but proceeded slowly to deploy AMI-enabled programs that benefit consumers. High bill alert (HBA) programs, which inform consumers of unusually high usage patterns, offer an avenue for tapping AMI-enabled benefits. We evaluate an HBA program and find that the program reduced mean electricity and natural gas consumption by about 0.5%. The effects were largest at the top of the usage distribution, especially when normalized by preprogram usage, indicating that households experienced fewer expenditure shocks. Estimates of the program’s benefits and costs illustrate the importance of considering the forgone value of conserved energy when evaluating demand-side management programs in the energy sector.
records.abstract_cn: 公用事业公司在先进计量基础设施（AMI）方面投资了数十亿美元，但在部署有利于消费者的AMI支持项目方面进展缓慢。高账单预警（HBA）项目，向消费者通报异常高的用量模式，为利用AMI支持的利益提供了途径。我们评估了一个HBA项目，发现该项目使平均用电和天然气消费分别减少了0.5%。效果在用量分布的顶部最为显著，特别是在用量归一化到项目前用量的情况下，表明家庭经历的支出冲击较少。对该项目的收益和成本的估算显示，在评估能源行业需求侧管理项目时，考虑节约能源的放弃价值具有重要意义。

records.journal_name: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
records.title_en: Irrigation and Climate Change: Long-Run Adaptation and Its Externalities
records.title_cn: 灌溉与气候变化：长期适应及其外部性
records.abstract_en: As the largest user of water, irrigated agriculture accounts for 20% of global cropland and over 40% of food production. Irrigation is also a potential adaptive response to climate change. This study examines the extent to which the current global irrigation footprint reflects climate change over the last 50 years. Utilizing variation in local climate, I find that increasing drought conditions over time are associated with irrigation expansion in areas with groundwater potential. The results hold both globally and in the United States. GRACE satellite data suggest that this expansion of irrigation can contribute to aquifer stress and increased soil salinity, which represent potential negative externalities of climate adaptation and a threat to future food security.
records.abstract_cn: 作为最大的用水部门，灌溉农业占全球耕地的20%和粮食产量的40%以上。灌溉也是应对气候变化的潜在适应性措施。本研究考察了当前全球灌溉分布在多大程度上反映了过去50年的气候变化。利用局部气候的变异性，我发现随着时间推移，干旱条件的加剧与地下水潜力地区的灌溉扩张相关。这一结果在全球和美国均成立。GRACE卫星数据表明，灌溉的扩张可能导致含水层压力增加和土壤盐碱化加剧，这代表了气候适应的潜在负外部性，并对未来粮食安全构成威胁。

records.journal_name: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
records.title_en: Droughts and Economic Activity: Do Dams and Groundwater Mediate the Impact?
records.title_cn: 干旱与经济活动：水坝和地下水是否调节影响？
records.abstract_en: This study examines the effects of droughts on economic activity, proxied by nighttime lights. Using two different indices of drought severity, one remotely sensed and one from ground-sensed meteorological data, we provide some of the first global estimates of the economic effects of drought, as opposed to temperature and precipitation. Economic impacts depend on drought severity, with moderate-or-worse droughts reducing luminosity by about 2%. Water storage in the form of accessible groundwater mitigates drought impacts. Dams moderate the effects of all but the most extreme droughts. For moderate or worse droughts, negative effects are fully offset by the presence of dams, unless some dams are hydroelectric. Upstream dams do not appear to create harmful spillovers for drought resilience downstream. Results are robust to allowing separate mediating impacts from irrigation and suggest that the resilience benefits of dams and groundwater extend beyond agriculture.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究考察干旱对经济活动的影响，以夜间灯光作为代理变量。利用不同的干旱严重程度指数，包括遥感的一和地面观测的一，我们提供了部分关于干旱对经济影响的全球估计，特别是相对于温度和降水的影响。经济影响依赖于干旱的严重程度，中度或更严重的干旱会使光度降低大约2%。可利用的地下水水储存缓解了干旱的影响。水坝可以缓和除极端干旱之外的所有干旱影响。对于中度或更严重的干旱，除非水坝为水电站，否则水坝的负面影响会被完全抵消。上游水坝似乎不会对下游的抗旱能力产生有害的溢出效应。结果对允许灌溉带来的调节影响的分开考虑具有稳健性，并且表明水坝和地下水的抗旱韧性益处超越了农业领域。

records.journal_name: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
records.title_en: A Hedge Fund in Your Garage: Automobile Purchases Under Gasoline Price Uncertainty
records.title_cn: 车库中的对冲基金：汽油价格不确定性下的汽车购买
records.abstract_en: College education, homeownership, and automobiles are all examples of purchases where consumers sink a large up-front investment expecting to enjoy a stream of future net benefits. Often those benefits are uncertain at the time of purchase. We consider how uncertainty in future operating costs impacts the choice of vehicle fuel economy. Using measures of future gasoline price uncertainty from real options theory and comprehensive data on sales of automobiles in the United States, we find that future gasoline price uncertainty has economically meaningful impacts on vehicle demand, with a one standard deviation increase in the variance of the future price distribution increasing willingness to pay for fuel economy by 6.7%, slightly improving mean fuel economy but substantially reducing short-run vehicle sales. This new finding has implications for transportation policies that may introduce new uncertainties in future vehicle operating costs.
records.abstract_cn: 高校教育、房屋所有权和汽车都是消费者在预期未来净收益流中投入大量前期资金的购买例子。这些未来收益在购买时往往具有不确定性。我们考虑未来运营成本不确定性如何影响车辆燃油经济性的选择。利用来自期权理论的未来汽油价格不确定性指标以及美国汽车销售的全面数据，我们发现未来汽油价格不确定性对车辆需求具有具有经济意义的影响，未来价格分布方差每增加一个标准差，消费者愿意为燃油经济性支付的意愿增加6.7%，略微改善平均燃油经济性，但在短期内显著减少车辆销售。这一新发现对可能引入未来车辆运营成本新不确定性的交通政策具有启示意义。

records.journal_name: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
records.title_en: Causal Inference, High-Frequency Data, and the Recreational Value of Water Quality
records.title_cn: 因果推断、高频数据与水质休闲价值
records.abstract_en: Emerging datasets capture rich temporal variation in recreation behavior, but recreation demand analyses have traditionally used variation across sites, rather than across time, to value environmental amenities. We introduce a model and estimation procedure designed to exploit panel variation in recreation demand analyses by embedding panel data causal inference techniques within a travel cost random utility model. To demonstrate the method, we use “structural synthetic controls” to value the welfare losses caused by water-quality-induced beach closures in southeast Michigan. Losses tend to be larger on weekends and hotter days, and our results suggest that a stigma effect reduces visitation even after the beach reopens. Our method is particularly useful for valuing the recreational impacts of resource shocks, like harmful algal blooms or wildfires, and it can be applied broadly given the increasing availability of high-frequency recreation data.
records.abstract_cn: 新兴数据集捕捉了休闲行为中的丰富时间变异，但休闲需求分析传统上利用不同地点之间的变异，而非时间上的变异，来评估环境设施的价值。我们引入一种模型和估计程序，旨在通过将面板数据因果推断技术嵌入旅游成本随机效用模型中，利用面板变异进行休闲需求分析。为展示该方法，我们采用“结构合成控制”方法，评估由水质引起的海滩关闭在东南密歇根地区造成的福利损失。损失在周末和天气较热的日子更为显著，我们的结果表明，即使海滩重新开放后，污名效应仍会降低访客数量。我们的方法对于评估资源冲击（如有害藻华或野火）引起的休闲影响特别有用，并且随着高频休闲数据的日益丰富，该方法具有广泛的应用潜力。

records.journal_name: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
records.title_en: The Urban Equilibrium Effects of Electric Vehicle Tax Credits
records.title_cn: 电动车税收抵免的城市均衡效应
records.abstract_en: This study extends the monocentric city model to incorporate endogenous household automobile fuel choice and dwelling energy consumption. Electric vehicle (EV) tax credits lower direct energy consumption and emissions via commuting but also cause important urban general equilibrium effects, including sprawl. This creates a substantial emissions rebound effect via larger homes, longer commutes, and greater consumption of the numeraire good. Nevertheless, EV tax credits are welfare enhancing unless electricity production is heavily tilted toward coal, with total household energy consumption and carbon emissions falling substantially.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究将单中心城市模型扩展到考虑家庭汽车燃料选择和居住能源消费的内生性。电动车（EV）税收抵免通过通勤降低直接能源消耗和排放，但也引发重要的城市一般均衡效应，包括城市蔓延。这导致通过更大的住房、更长的通勤距离和更高的名义商品消费产生显著的排放反弹效应。尽管如此，除非电力生产严重偏向煤炭，否则电动车税收抵免有助于提高福利，总体家庭能源消耗和碳排放也会大幅下降。

records.journal_name: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
records.title_en: Environmental Liability, Insurance, and Market Structure in Coal Mining
records.title_cn: 环境责任、保险与煤炭开采市场结构
records.abstract_en: This study examines a Pennsylvania policy reform that increased bonded liability for coal mines with reclamation obligations. A 2001 change for surface mines was largely priced into existing reclamation insurance mechanisms, which exist to prevent mines from shirking their liabilities. We find that the changes increased mine-level insured liability and idling (≈15% for median mines), led to declines in production, and did not change environmental performance directly for treated mines. However, we do find that these effects were driven largely by higher polluting mines. Major results are robust to both comparing bituminous and anthracite mines within Pennsylvania as well as bituminous mines between Pennsylvania and Virginia.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了宾夕法尼亚州一项政策改革，该改革增加了具有复垦义务的煤矿的保证责任。表面矿的2001变动在很大程度上已被现有的复垦保险机制所反映，该机制旨在防止矿山逃避其责任。我们发现，这些变化增加了矿山层面的保险责任和停产（约为15%的中位数矿山），导致产量下降，并未直接改变受影响矿山的环境表现。然而，我们也发现，这些影响主要由污染较重的矿山驱动。主要结果在将宾夕法尼亚州的褐煤矿与无烟煤矿进行比较，以及在宾夕法尼亚州与弗吉尼亚州的褐煤矿之间的比较中均具有稳健性。

records.title_en: Introduction by the Editor
records.title_cn: 编者简介
records.abstract_en: This Special Issue of The Economic Journal brings together papers at the frontier of dynamic, spatial and heterogeneous-agent structural modelling for the study of climate change and climate policy. These models are designed to be consistent with the fundamentals of climate science and to be calibrated and/or taken to the data. In this respect, Eftekhari, Folini, Friedl, Kubler, Scheidegger and Schenk contribute a methodological paper to the Issue, developing efficient climate emulators that can be embedded within economic models of climate change. Centring on the link between climate change and inequality, the papers in the Issue span different, and often complementary, dimensions of heterogeneity in the effects of climate change and various mitigation policies, most notably carbon taxes. Taken together, they show that the distributional consequences of climate action depend crucially on where a policy is implemented, how markets transmit shocks across regions and countries, and which households or regions are most exposed through income, wealth, consumption baskets, production structures or demographic characteristics.
records.abstract_cn: 本期《经济杂志》特刊汇集了动态、空间和异质主体结构模型前沿的论文，用于气候变化和气候政策的研究。这些模型的设计符合气候科学的基础知识，并进行校准和/或获取数据。在这方面，Eftekhari、Folini、Friedl、Kubler、Scheidegger 和 Schenk 为本期贡献了一篇方法论论文，开发了可以嵌入气候变化经济模型中的高效气候模拟器。本期论文以气候变化与不平等之间的联系为中心，涵盖了气候变化和各种缓解政策（尤其是碳税）影响的不同且往往是互补的异质性维度。总而言之，它们表明，气候行动的分配后果在很大程度上取决于政策的实施地点、市场如何在地区和国家之间传递冲击，以及哪些家庭或地区在收入、财富、消费篮子、生产结构或人口特征方面受到的影响最大。

records.title_en: On the Geographic Implications of Carbon Taxes
records.title_cn: 论碳税的地理影响
records.abstract_en: Using a multi-sector dynamic spatial integrated assessment model, we argue that a carbon tax introduced by the European Union and rebated locally can, if not too large, increase the size of Europe’s economy by concentrating economic activity in its high-productivity non-agricultural core and by incentivising immigration to the European Union. The resulting change in the spatial distribution of economic activity improves global efficiency and welfare. A carbon tax introduced by the United States generates similar effects. This stands in sharp contrast with standard models that ignore trade and migration in a world shaped by economic geography forces.
records.abstract_cn: 使用多部门动态空间综合评估模型，我们认为，欧盟引入并在当地退税的碳税可以通过将经济活动集中在其高生产率的非农业核心并通过激励移民到欧盟来增加欧洲经济的规模（如果不是太大的话）。由此产生的经济活动空间分布的变化提高了全球效率和福利。美国征收的碳税也产生了类似的效果。这与在经济地理力量塑造的世界中忽视贸易和移民的标准模型形成鲜明对比。

records.title_en: The Winners and Losers of Climate Policies: A Sufficient Statistics Approach
records.title_cn: 气候政策的赢家和输家：充分的统计方法
records.abstract_en: To combat global warming, climate policies like carbon taxes, renewable subsidies and carbon tariffs must be implemented to phase out fossil fuel consumption and lower emissions. Who are the winners and losers of such policies? Through a simple integrated assessment model with heterogeneous countries and international trade in goods and energy, we study both the costs of implementing these policies unilaterally and the local costs and global gains of international policy cooperation. To do so, we express and decompose welfare changes under different policy regimes to the first order as a function of sufficient statistics that depend on observables and identifiable elasticities, such as nations’ energy mix, energy rents, trade shares, energy supply and demand elasticities, and damage parameters. We show that climate change has non-trivial reallocation effects through international trade in goods and energy. Pursuing unilateral policies generates strong leakage effects, primarily through energy trade. Global climate policy cooperation mitigates leakage, but not all countries have an incentive to participate. Regional climate clubs operate differently: an EU-wide club reduces global emissions but creates internal winners and losers, while an Association of Southeast Asian Nations climate club achieves smaller global gains, but delivers welfare increases for member nations.
records.abstract_cn: 为了应对全球变暖，必须实施碳税、可再生能源补贴和碳关税等气候政策，以逐步淘汰化石燃料消耗并降低排放。这些政策的赢家和输家是谁？通过对异质国家以及国际货物和能源贸易的简单综合评估模型，我们研究单方面实施这些政策的成本以及国际政策合作的当地成本和全球收益。为此，我们将不同政策体制下的福利变化表达并分解为第一顺序，作为充分统计数据的函数，这些统计数据依赖于可观察的和可识别的弹性，例如国家的能源结构、能源租金、贸易份额、能源供需弹性和损害参数。我们表明，气候变化通过国际货物和能源贸易具有重要的重新分配效应。奉行单边政策会产生强烈的泄漏效应，主要是通过能源贸易。全球气候政策合作减少了泄漏，但并非所有国家都有参与的动力。区域气候俱乐部的运作方式不同：欧盟范围内的俱乐部减少了全球排放，但创造了内部赢家和输家，而东南亚国家联盟气候俱乐部实现了较小的全球收益，但为成员国带来了福利增加。

records.title_en: A Macro Study of the Unequal Effects of Climate Change
records.title_cn: 气候变化不平等影响的宏观研究
records.abstract_en: This paper develops a macro heterogeneous-agent model to quantify the distributional impacts of higher temperatures resulting from climate change in the United States. Households adapt to temperature through two channels: an intensive margin—adjusting energy use for heating and cooling—and an extensive margin—deciding whether to purchase temperature-control equipment such as a heater, air conditioner or heat pump. I estimate the production functions for household heating and cooling from a unique product-level data set and calibrate the remaining parameters to match variation in energy expenditures and budget shares with income levels. I find that the welfare effects of climate change vary substantially with income and region. In colder areas, climate change increases inequality in lifetime welfare. While all households experience greater cooling needs, the costs are particularly acute for lower-income households, who purchase air conditioners that they did not previously need. In warmer areas, the opposite pattern reduces welfare inequality.
records.abstract_cn: 本文开发了一个宏观异质主体模型来量化美国气候变化导致气温升高的分布影响。家庭通过二渠道适应温度：集约裕度——调整供暖和制冷的能源使用——以及外延裕度——决定是否购买暖气、空调或热泵等温控设备。我根据独特的产品级数据集估算了家庭供暖和制冷的生产函数，并校准其余参数，以匹配能源支出和预算份额与收入水平的变化。我发现气候变化对福利的影响因收入和地区的不同而有很大差异。在寒冷地区，气候变化加剧了终生福利的不平等。虽然所有家庭都面临着更大的制冷需求，但对于低收入家庭来说，成本尤其严重，因为他们购买了以前不需要的空调。在较温暖的地区，相反的模式减少了福利不平等。

records.title_en: Carbon Pricing and Inequality: A Normative Perspective
records.title_cn: 碳定价和不平等：规范视角
records.abstract_en: Despite broad acceptance among economists, carbon taxes face persistent public resistance. We measure the sources and distribution of welfare losses from unexpected European carbon price changes by estimating their impact on consumer prices, labour income, financial wealth and government transfers. A 1% carbon-policy-induced increase in energy prices leads to an average welfare loss of about 0.5% of a household’s three-year consumption, primarily driven by indirect labour-income effects. Younger, poorer and less educated households, especially in Southern and Eastern Europe, bear a disproportionate burden. These findings suggest that public opposition to carbon taxes could stem from legitimate distributional concerns.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管碳税得到经济学家的广泛接受，但仍面临公众的持续抵制。我们通过估计欧洲碳价格意外变化对消费者价格、劳动力收入、金融财富和政府转移支付的影响来衡量其福利损失的来源和分布。 1%碳政策引发的能源价格上涨导致家庭三年消费的平均福利损失约为0.5%，这主要是由间接劳动收入效应驱动的。年轻、贫穷和受教育程度较低的家庭，特别是在南欧和东欧，承受着不成比例的负担。这些发现表明，公众对碳税的反对可能源于合理的分配担忧。

records.title_en: The Unequal Costs of Carbon Pricing: Economic and Political Effects Across European Regions
records.title_cn: 碳定价的不平等成本：欧洲地区的经济和政治影响
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the economic and political effects of carbon pricing across European regions. Our main finding is that a well-identified increase in carbon prices reduces emissions, but entails economic and political costs: higher carbon prices significantly reduce output and employment while increasing vote shares for extremist and populist parties, contributing to political fragmentation. Consistent with an economic voting channel, opinion surveys reveal a more pessimistic economic outlook and declining environmental concerns among respondents. Importantly, the economic and political costs are not borne equally: carbon-intensive regions experience a larger decline in output and see a stronger shift to extremist political parties. Our findings highlight the need for complementary policies to mitigate the unequal economic impacts of carbon pricing and the associated political backlash.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了欧洲地区碳定价的经济和政治影响。我们的主要发现是，明确的碳价格上涨会减少排放，但会带来经济和政治成本：较高的碳价格会显着减少产出和就业，同时增加极端主义和民粹主义政党的选票比例，从而导致政治分裂。与经济投票渠道一致，民意调查显示受访者对经济前景更加悲观，对环境的担忧有所下降。重要的是，经济和政治成本的承担并不相同：碳密集地区的产出下降幅度更大，并且更强烈地转向极端主义政党。我们的研究结果强调需要采取补充政策来减轻碳定价带来的不平等经济影响以及相关的政治抵制。

records.title_en: Distributional Consequences of Becoming Climate-Neutral
records.title_cn: 成为气候中和的分配后果
records.abstract_en: The EU has embarked on an ambitious path towards climate neutrality. How difficult will this transition be for the population as a whole and for different subsets of consumers? This paper investigates this question using a dynamic general-equilibrium model that captures a key feature of energy consumption: the relative energy content of one’s consumption basket falls significantly as a function of one’s relative income. Thus, low-income consumers are expected to be hit harder by the higher energy prices that we anticipate over the next few decades. In the model, energy—a complementary input to capital and labour—can be produced either using fossil fuel or a ‘green’ technology. We represent the EU policy in terms of a tax on fossil fuel and show that the European Commission’s Fit-for-55 package implies a 106.4% tax on the fossil-based technology. The output losses from this tax are substantial, and GDP is 6.3% lower in the new steady state. The burden falls primarily on the lowest-income agent, who represents the first income quintile and is 47% more worse off than the highest-income agent, representing the fifth quintile. The output losses can almost be cut in half if the economy achieves a simultaneous increase in energy efficiency, as outlined in the Fit-for-55 package.
records.abstract_cn: 欧盟已经踏上了一条雄心勃勃的气候中和之路。对于整个人口和不同的消费者群体来说，这种转变有多困难？本文使用动态一般均衡模型研究了这个问题，该模型捕捉了能源消费的一个关键特征：一消费篮子的相对能源含量随着一相对收入的函数而显着下降。因此，我们预计未来几十年能源价格上涨将对低收入消费者造成更严重的打击。在该模型中，能源（资本和劳动力的补充投入）可以使用化石燃料或“绿色”技术来生产。我们代表欧盟在化石燃料税方面的政策，并表明欧盟委员会的 Fit-for-55 一揽子计划意味着对化石燃料技术征收 106.4% 税。该税收造成的产出损失相当大，并且在新的稳定状态下 GDP 较低 6.3%。负担主要落在收入最低的代理人身上，他们代表第一收入五分之一，并且47%比代表第五五分之一的最高收入代理人更糟糕。正如 Fit-for-55 一揽子计划所述，如果经济同时实现能源效率的提高，产出损失几乎可以减少一半。

records.title_en: Inequality Along the European Green Transition
records.title_cn: 欧洲绿色转型中的不平等
records.abstract_en: The EU aims for 42.5% green energy consumption by 2030. What are the effects of the European green transition on inequality? We answer this question using a heterogeneous-agent model with non-homothetic preferences for energy and non-energy goods, calibrated to European data. We study the impact of an increase in carbon taxes designed to meet the EU target under different revenue-recycling strategies. Redistributing tax revenues via uniform transfers reduces consumption inequality, shifts the welfare burden to high-income households, but leads to significant output losses. Subsidising green energy producers boosts energy production, reduces output losses and requires a smaller carbon tax to meet the EU target. However, it increases consumption and income inequality, with the highest welfare costs borne by low-income and asset-poor households. Our findings highlight key trade-offs between equity and efficiency in green transition policies.
records.abstract_cn: 欧盟的目标是到42.5%实现2030绿色能源消耗。欧洲绿色转型对不平等有何影响？我们使用对能源和非能源商品具有非相似偏好的异质代理模型来回答这个问题，并根据欧洲数据进行校准。我们研究了在不同收入回收策略下为实现欧盟目标而增加碳税的影响。通过统一转移支付重新分配税收收入可以减少消费不平等，将福利负担转移给高收入家庭，但会导致严重的产出损失。补贴绿色能源生产商可以提高能源产量，减少产出损失，并需要降低碳税来实现欧盟目标。然而，它加剧了消费和收入不平等，低收入和资产匮乏的家庭承担了最高的福利成本。我们的研究结果强调了绿色转型政策中公平与效率之间的关键权衡。

records.title_en: Optimal Fiscal Policy in a Climate-Economy Model with Heterogeneous Households
records.title_cn: 异质家庭气候经济模型中的最优财政政策
records.abstract_en: We study optimal fiscal policy to address climate change and inequality. We theoretically characterise optimal carbon and income taxes and quantify them for the US economy using a climate model calibrated to DICE. In contrast to the representative-agent setting, we find that (i) tax distortions have a negligible effect on the optimal carbon tax; (ii) inequality only slightly reduces it; (iii) the revenue from carbon taxes is optimally split about equally between reducing tax distortions and increasing transfers. Unlike the double-dividend policy, optimal carbon taxation has progressive welfare effects, and low-income households benefit even in the short run.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究解决气候变化和不平等问题的最佳财政政策。我们从理论上描述了最佳碳税和所得税，并使用根据 DICE 校准的气候模型对美国经济进行量化。与代表-代理设置相反，我们发现（i）税收扭曲对最优碳税的影响可以忽略不计； (ii) 不平等仅略微降低这一程度； (iii) 碳税收入最好在减少税收扭曲和增加转移之间平均分配。与双红利政策不同，最优碳税具有累进福利效应，低收入家庭即使在短期内也能受益。

records.title_en: Optimal Climate Policy with Demographic Transitions
records.title_cn: 人口结构转变的最佳气候政策
records.abstract_en: This paper develops a framework to integrate demographic change into climate policy analysis. We build an overlapping-generations climate-economy model with a rich demographic structure, allowing population growth and survival probabilities to vary over time. These features endogenously determine the age composition of society and shape aggregate preferences. A central result of our framework is an aggregation result: despite the heterogeneity across cohorts, the planner’s problem can be recast as a representative-agent model with a time-varying social discount factor that reflects demographic dynamics. Notably, as the population ages, the discount factor declines, causing society to behave as if it were more impatient. We use this framework to study how current global demographic trends affect the social cost of carbon—the model-based measure of the economic cost of climate change. We find that this cost is significantly higher under medium- and high-fertility scenarios, driven by greater emissions from larger populations. These effects are partially offset by higher discounting in ageing societies. Relative to a benchmark model with no demographic change, the initial social cost of carbon rises by 20% under medium fertility and by 57% under high fertility. Global temperatures also increase more sharply in these scenarios, suggesting that demographic trends will exacerbate the climate problem.
records.abstract_cn: 本文开发了一个将人口变化纳入气候政策分析的框架。我们建立了一个具有丰富人口结构的代际重叠气候经济模型，允许人口增长和生存概率随时间变化。这些特征内生地决定了社会的年龄构成并塑造了总体偏好。我们框架的核心结果是聚合结果：尽管群体之间存在异质性，但规划者的问题可以重新构建为具有反映人口动态的随时间变化的社会折扣因子的代表-代理模型。值得注意的是，随着人口老龄化，贴现系数下降，导致社会表现得更加不耐烦。我们利用这个框架来研究当前的全球人口趋势如何影响碳的社会成本——基于模型的气候变化经济成本衡量标准。我们发现，在中等和高生育率情景下，由于人口较多导致排放量增加，这一成本明显更高。这些影响被老龄化社会更高的折扣所部分抵消。相对于没有人口变化的基准模型，碳的初始社会成本在中等生育率下上升20%，在高生育率下上升57%。在这些情况下，全球气温也会急剧上升，这表明人口趋势将加剧气候问题。

records.title_en: Diet, Economic Development and Climate Change
records.title_cn: 饮食、经济发展和气候变化
records.abstract_en: We develop a quantitative, multi-country general equilibrium framework to study the impact of economic growth, dietary restrictions and food trade policies on global greenhouse-gas (GHG) emissions from agriculture. Motivated by new cross-country relationships between economic development, diet patterns, agricultural technologies and GHG emissions, our framework features different income elasticities of demand across food products and multiple agricultural technologies for production across grid cells covering the surface of the Earth, with food products and technologies being heterogeneous in their GHG emissions per calorie. Using our model’s open-economy structure, we propose a simple procedure to estimate the income elasticities without price data. We find that GHG emissions following economic growth are strongly influenced by general equilibrium effects related to dietary changes, agricultural modernisation and food supply readjustments. Moreover, compared with food trade policies, dietary restrictions are both substantially more effective in reducing GHG emissions and more favourable when considering the welfare losses in developing countries.
records.abstract_cn: 我们制定了定量的多国一般均衡框架，以研究经济增长、饮食限制和食品贸易政策对全球农业温室气体 (GHG) 排放的影响。在经济发展、饮食模式、农业技术和温室气体排放之间新的跨国关系的推动下，我们的框架具有不同的食品需求收入弹性和覆盖地球表面的网格单元的多种农业生产技术，食品和技术的每卡路里温室气体排放量是不同的。利用我们模型的开放经济结构，我们提出了一个简单的程序来估计没有价格数据的收入弹性。我们发现经济增长后的温室气体排放受到与饮食变化、农业现代化和食品供应调整相关的一般均衡效应的强烈影响。此外，与食品贸易政策相比，饮食限制在减少温室气体排放方面更加有效，而且在考虑发展中国家的福利损失时也更加有利。

records.title_en: Building Interpretable Climate Emulators for Economics
records.title_cn: 构建可解释的经济学气候模拟器
records.abstract_en: We introduce a framework for developing efficient and interpretable climate emulators for economic models of climate change. The paper makes two main contributions. First, we propose a general framework for constructing carbon cycle emulators for macroeconomic models. The framework is implemented as a generalised linear multi-reservoir (box) model that conserves key physical quantities and can be customised for specific applications. We consider three versions of the carbon cycle emulator, which we evaluate within a simple representative agent economic model: (i) a three-box setting comparable to DICE-2016; (ii) a four-box extension; and (iii) a four-box version that explicitly captures land use change. While the three-box model reproduces benchmark results well, and the fourth reservoir adds little, incorporating the impact of land use change on the carbon storage capacity of the terrestrial biosphere substantially alters atmospheric carbon stocks, temperature trajectories and the optimal mitigation path. Second, we investigate pattern-scaling techniques that transform global mean temperature projections from climate emulators into spatially heterogeneous warming fields. We show how regional baseline climates, non-uniform warming and the associated uncertainties propagate into economic damages.
records.abstract_cn: 我们引入了一个框架，用于为气候变化的经济模型开发高效且可解释的气候模拟器。论文做出二主要贡献。 第一，我们提出了构建宏观经济模型碳循环模拟器的总体框架。该框架被实现为广义线性多储层（盒）模型，该模型保留了关键物理量，并且可以针对特定应用进行定制。我们考虑碳循环模拟器的三版本，我们在一个简单的代表性代理经济模型中对其进行评估：（i）与DICE-2016相当的三框设置； (ii) 四-框扩展； (iii) 明确捕捉土地利用变化的四框版本。虽然三盒模型很好地再现了基准结果，并且第四水库增加很少，但考虑到土地利用变化对陆地生物圈碳储存能力的影响，大大改变了大气碳储量、温度轨迹和最佳缓解路径。 第二，我们研究了模式尺度技术，将气候模拟器的全球平均温度预测转化为空间异质变暖场。我们展示了区域基线气候、不均匀变暖以及相关的不确定性如何传播到经济损失。

records.title_en: Walras–Bowley Lecture: Climate Policy in the Wide World
records.title_cn: Walras–Bowley讲座：广阔世界中的气候政策
records.abstract_en: We construct a dynamic integrated assessment model of climate and the economy with very high geographic resolution. Migration is free within, but not allowed across, countries. The model parameterization uses a wealth of data, including the distribution of output, population, energy sources and use, and estimates of the local damages from climate change. It implies very large geographic dispersion in damages from warming. We conduct three kinds of policy experiments. In one, we note that a modest, uniform carbon tax limits global warming and damages around the world substantially. In a second experiment, we let the poorest countries not tax carbon, while the rest compensate by setting higher taxes; the efficiency losses are large. In a final experiment, we find that fast green technology growth alone is a poor substitute for carbon taxes, whether globally available or not.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个具有极高地理分辨率的气候与经济动态综合评估模型。模型中迁移在国家内部是自由的，但不允许跨国迁移。模型参数化采用了大量数据，包括产出分布、人口、能源来源与使用，以及对气候变化造成的地方性损害的估算。模型结果显示，气候变暖造成的损害在地理上存在极大的分散。我们进行了三类政策实验。第一类实验表明，适度且统一的碳税能显著限制全球变暖及世界各地的损害。第二类实验中，最贫困国家不征收碳税，而其他国家通过提高碳税进行补偿；效率损失很大。最后一类实验发现，无论绿色技术增长是否全球可用，仅依靠快速绿色技术增长都无法有效替代碳税。

records.title_en: Identification in Instrumental Variables Models: The Central Role of Abadie's Kappa
records.title_cn: 工具变量模型中的识别：Abadie Kappa的核心作用
records.abstract_en: We study instrumental variables models characterized by: (i) Unobserved heterogeneity consisting of potential outcomes and response types that describe how the instrument determines treatment choice; (ii) Conditional independence of the instrument and the unobserved heterogeneity; and (iii) Convex restrictions on the distribution of unobserved heterogeneity. We show certain causal parameters are identified in these models if and only if a version of the kappa of Abadie (2003) exists. Our identification results are constructive in yielding estimating moment conditions. Focusing on a leading special case, we develop asymptotically normal estimators based on a doubly robust version of these moment conditions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了工具变量模型，其特征包括：(i) 未观测异质性，包括潜在结果和响应类型，描述工具变量如何决定处理选择；(ii) 工具变量与未观测异质性条件独立；(iii) 对未观测异质性分布的凸性限制。我们证明，在这些模型中，某些因果参数当且仅当存在Abadie (2003)的kappa版本时才被识别。我们的识别结果具有建设性，能够产生估计的矩条件。聚焦于一个主要的特殊情形，我们基于这些矩条件的双重稳健版本，开发了渐近正态的估计量。

records.title_en: Firm‐to‐Firm Trade: Imports, Exports, and the Labor Market
records.title_cn: 企业间贸易：进口、出口与劳动力市场
records.abstract_en: Customs data reveal the heterogeneity and granularity of relationships among buyers and sellers, showing how more exports to a destination break down into more firms selling there and more buyers per exporter. We develop a quantitative general equilibrium model of firm‐to‐firm matching that builds on this insight to separate the roles of iceberg costs and matching frictions in gravity. In the cross section, we find matching frictions as important as iceberg costs in impeding trade, and more sensitive to distance. Because domestic and imported intermediates compete directly with labor in performing production tasks, our model also fits the heterogeneity of labor shares across French producers. Applying the framework to the 2004 expansion of the European Union, reduced iceberg costs and reduced matching frictions contributed equally to the increase in French exports to the new members. While workers benefited overall, those competing most directly with imports gained less, even losing in some countries entering the EU.
records.abstract_cn: 海关数据揭示了买卖双方关系的异质性和细粒度特征，显示出口到某一目的地的增加，既体现在更多企业向该地销售，也体现在每个出口商拥有更多买家。我们基于这一见解，构建了一个企业间匹配的定量一般均衡模型，以区分冰山成本和匹配摩擦在引力模型中的作用。在截面数据中，我们发现匹配摩擦与冰山成本同等重要，且对距离更为敏感。由于国内和进口中间品在生产任务中与劳动力直接竞争，我们的模型也能够拟合法国生产者间劳动份额的异质性。将该框架应用于2004年欧盟扩员，冰山成本降低和匹配摩擦减少对法国对新成员国出口的增长贡献相等。虽然工人总体受益，但与进口直接竞争最激烈的工人受益较少，甚至在部分新加入欧盟的国家出现损失。

records.title_en: Information Design in Common Value Auction With Moral Hazard: Application to OCS Leasing Auctions
records.title_cn: 道德风险下的共同价值拍卖中的信息设计：应用于OCS租赁拍卖
records.abstract_en: This paper explores the impact of information design on the auctioneer's revenue in the U.S. offshore oil/gas lease auctions where, post‐auction, the winner decides whether to explore the auctioned tract and must pay the government a royalty on its production value. I first document that there is a positive correlation between the exploration rate and publicly observed losing bids. This suggests that the winning bidder uses the rivals' bids to infer their private information about the tract's potential. I then characterize the equilibrium bidding strategy when the auctioneer designs and commits to how to reveal information on losing bids to the winning bidder. Counterfactual exercises reveal that alternative bid disclosure policies significantly improve auctioneer revenue.
records.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了信息设计对美国近海油气租赁拍卖中拍卖人收入的影响。在该拍卖中，拍卖结束后，获胜者决定是否勘探拍卖地块，并必须向政府支付其产值的特许权使用费。首先，作者发现勘探率与公开观察到的落标出价之间存在正相关关系。这表明获胜竞标者利用竞争对手的出价来推断他们关于地块潜力的私人信息。随后，作者刻画了当拍卖人设计并承诺如何向获胜者披露落标出价信息时的均衡竞标策略。反事实分析显示，替代性的出价披露政策显著提升了拍卖人的收入。

records.title_en: The Equilibrium Effects of Campaign Finance Deregulation on U.S. Elections
records.title_cn: 竞选资金放松管制对美国选举的均衡效应
records.abstract_en: The U.S. Supreme Court's 2010 decision in Citizens United v. Federal Election Commission deregulated campaign finance, enabling the rise of a new political action committee (the Super PAC) with broad freedom to raise and spend money. This led to an unprecedented surge in spending in primary and general elections. To evaluate the impact of Super PACs, I estimate a multistage model of political competition using data from U.S. Congressional elections between 2010 and 2020. I find that Super PAC spending by both sides prompts offsetting responses, resulting in limited net equilibrium effects. However, by amplifying the role of donors, Super PACs still have the potential to reshape the electoral landscape.
records.abstract_cn: 美国最高法院在2010年“公民联合诉联邦选举委员会”案中放松了竞选资金管制，使新型政治行动委员会（超级政治行动委员会）能够自由筹集和支出资金。这导致初选和大选中的支出出现前所未有的激增。为评估超级政治行动委员会的影响，本文采用2010年至2020年美国国会选举数据，估计一个多阶段政治竞争模型。研究发现，双方的超级政治行动委员会支出引发了相互抵消的反应，导致净均衡效应有限。然而，超级政治行动委员会通过强化捐赠者的作用，仍有可能重塑选举格局。

records.title_en: Dynamic Screening of Buyers With Heterogeneous Purchase Frequency
records.title_cn: 具有异质购买频率的买方动态筛选
records.abstract_en: We consider a dynamic buyer–seller interaction. Instead of the buyer's valuation, it is the frequency with which he needs to trade that is the buyer's private information. The difference matters. With commitment, full surplus extraction is possible, for instance via limited‐time offers. Without commitment, ratcheting is mitigated, as not buying is not necessarily a sign of strength. Because time is informative, the seller learns and may adjust her behavior over time. When finding a suitable alternative seller is easy, she starts with a pooling offer before permanently switching to a screening offer. When finding a suitable alternative seller takes time, she starts with a pooling offer before occasionally experimenting with separating offers.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了买卖双方的动态互动。买方的私人信息不是其估值，而是其需要交易的频率。这一区别具有重要意义。在有承诺的情况下，可以实现全部剩余的提取，例如通过限时优惠。在无承诺的情况下，逐步加码现象被缓解，因为不购买并不一定是强势的表现。由于时间具有信息性，卖方会学习并可能随着时间调整其行为。当找到合适的替代卖方很容易时，卖方会先提出混合报价，然后永久转向筛选报价。当找到合适的替代卖方需要时间时，卖方会先提出混合报价，然后偶尔尝试分离报价。

records.title_en: The Inference‐Forecast Gap in Belief Updating
records.title_cn: 信念更新中的推断-预测差距
records.abstract_en: Evidence from the laboratory and the field has uncovered both underreaction and overreaction to new information. We provide new experimental evidence on the underlying mechanisms of under‐ and overreaction by comparing how people make inferences and revise forecasts in the same information environment. Participants underreact to signals when inferring about underlying states, but overreact to the same signals when revising forecasts about future outcomes—a phenomenon we term “the inference‐forecast gap.” We show that this gap is largely driven by different simplifying heuristics used in the two tasks. Additional treatments suggest that the choice of heuristics is affected by the similarity between statistics in the information environment and the statistic elicited by the belief‐updating problem.
records.abstract_cn: 实验室和实地证据揭示了对新信息的反应不足和反应过度。我们通过比较人们在相同信息环境下如何进行推断和修正预测，提供了关于反应不足与反应过度的内在机制的新实验证据。参与者在推断潜在状态时对信号反应不足，但在修正对未来结果的预测时对同一信号反应过度——我们将这一现象称为“推断-预测差距”。我们发现，这一差距主要由两项任务中采用的不同简化启发式所驱动。额外的处理表明，启发式的选择受到信息环境中的统计量与信念更新问题所需统计量之间相似性的影响。

records.title_en: Double Robustness of Local Projections and Some Unpleasant VARithmetic
records.title_cn: 局部投影的双重稳健性与一些令人不快的VAR运算
records.abstract_en: We consider impulse response inference in a locally misspecified vector autoregression (VAR) model. The conventional local projection (LP) confidence interval has correct coverage even when the misspecification is so large that it can be detected with probability approaching 1. This result follows from a “double robustness” property analogous to that of popular partially linear regression estimators. By contrast, the conventional VAR confidence interval with short‐to‐moderate lag length can severely undercover for misspecification that is small, difficult to detect statistically, and cannot be ruled out based on economic theory. The VAR confidence interval has robust coverage if, and only if, the lag length is so large that the interval is as wide as the LP interval.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考察在局部设定错误的向量自回归（VAR）模型中脉冲响应的推断。即使设定错误的程度大到几乎可以被概率为1检测到，传统的局部投影（LP）置信区间仍能保持正确的覆盖率。这一结果源于类似于流行的部分线性回归估计量的“双重稳健性”特性。相比之下，传统的VAR置信区间在滞后阶数较短或中等时，对于经济理论无法排除且统计上难以检测的小幅设定错误，可能严重低估覆盖率。VAR置信区间只有在滞后阶数足够大、以至于区间宽度与LP区间相当时，才能实现稳健的覆盖率。

records.title_en: The Class Gap in Career Progression: Evidence From U.S. Academia
records.title_cn: 职业晋升中的阶级差距：来自美国学术界的证据
records.abstract_en: Unlike gender or race, class background is rarely a focus of research on career progression, or of DEI efforts in elite occupations. Should it be? In this paper, we document a large class gap in career progression in one occupation—U.S. tenure‐track academia—using parental education to proxy for class background. First‐generation college graduates are 10% less likely to be tenured at an R1, are tenured at institutions ranked 11% lower, earn 3% less, and report 5% lower job satisfaction, than their former PhD classmates (from the same institution and field) with a parent with a non‐PhD graduate degree. Neither selection out of academia nor different preferences explain this gap; differential research productivity also plays little role. Instead, likely drivers are differences in cultural and social capital. We also find a class gap in career progression for PhDs who work in industry, suggesting this phenomenon generalizes outside academia.
records.abstract_cn: 与性别或种族不同，阶级背景很少成为职业晋升研究或精英职业多元、平等与包容（DEI）工作的重点。它应该成为关注点吗？本文利用父母受教育程度作为阶级背景的代理变量，记录了美国终身教职学术界职业晋升中的显著阶级差距。第一代大学毕业生获得R1高校终身教职的概率比其博士同学（同校同领域、父母拥有非博士研究生学位）低10%，获得终身教职的院校排名低11%，收入低3%，工作满意度低5%。无论是学术界的筛选机制还是不同的偏好都无法解释这一差距，研究产出差异的作用也很小。更可能的驱动因素是文化资本和社会资本的差异。我们还发现，进入产业界工作的博士也存在职业晋升的阶级差距，表明这一现象不仅限于学术界。

records.title_en: Economic Growth and the Rise of Large Firms
records.title_cn: 经济增长与大型企业的崛起
records.abstract_en: I document that the right tail of the firm size distribution systematically thickens with economic development. To rationalize this fact, I develop a parsimonious idea search model in which both aggregate growth and the firm size distribution are endogenously determined. The model features an asymptotic balanced growth path along which Gibrat's law holds at each date, and the right tail of the firm size distribution thickens monotonically toward Zipf's law. The model also implies that policies favoring large firms can improve welfare by better utilizing the diffusion externalities arising from idea search.
